sections.text: ## Normal order of uncontracted terms within proto-algebra.

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.normalOrder_uncontracted_none
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
`𝓕.FieldOp`, and a `i ≤ φs.length`, then the following relation holds:

`𝓝([φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none]ᵘᶜ) = s • 𝓝(φ :: [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)`

where `s` is the exchange sign for `φ` and the uncontracted fields in `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁`.

The proof of this result ultimately is a consequence of `normalOrder_superCommute_eq_zero`.
declarations.statement:
lemma normalOrder_uncontracted_none (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none]ᵘᶜ)
    = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, φsΛ.uncontracted.filter (fun x => i.succAbove x < i)⟩) •
    𝓝(ofFieldOpList (φ :: [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ))

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.normalOrder_uncontracted_some
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
`𝓕.FieldOp`, a `i ≤ φs.length` and a `k` in `φsΛ.uncontracted`, then
`𝓝([φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)]ᵘᶜ)` is equal to the normal ordering of `[φsΛ]ᵘᶜ` with the `𝓕.FieldOp`
corresponding to `k` removed.

The proof of this result ultimately is a consequence of definitions.
declarations.statement:
lemma normalOrder_uncontracted_some (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)]ᵘᶜ)
    = 𝓝(ofFieldOpList (optionEraseZ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ φ ((uncontractedFieldOpEquiv φs φsΛ) k)))

declarations.name: WickContraction.staticWickTerm
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, and a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, the element
of `𝓕.WickAlgebra`, `φsΛ.staticWickTerm` is defined as

`φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.staticContract * 𝓝([φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)`.

This is a term which appears in the static version Wick's theorem.
declarations.statement: def staticWickTerm {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) : 𝓕.WickAlgebra

declarations.name: WickContraction.staticWickTerm_empty_nil
declarations.doc:
For the empty list `[]` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, the `staticWickTerm` of the Wick contraction
corresponding to the empty set `∅` (the only Wick contraction of `[]`) is `1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma staticWickTerm_empty_nil :
    staticWickTerm (empty (n := ([] : List 𝓕.FieldOp).length)) = 1

declarations.name: WickContraction.staticWickTerm_insert_zero_none
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, and an element `φ` of
  `𝓕.FieldOp`, then `(φsΛ ↩Λ φ 0 none).staticWickTerm` is equal to

`φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.staticWickTerm * 𝓝(φ :: [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)`

The proof of this result relies on
- `staticContract_insert_none` to rewrite the static contract.
- `sign_insert_none_zero` to rewrite the sign.
declarations.statement:
lemma staticWickTerm_insert_zero_none (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ 0 none).staticWickTerm =
    φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.staticContract * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList (φ :: [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ))

declarations.name: WickContraction.staticWickTerm_insert_zero_some
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
  `𝓕.FieldOp`, and a `k` in `φsΛ.uncontracted`, `(φsΛ ↩Λ φ 0 (some k)).wickTerm` is equal
  to the product of
- the sign `𝓢(φ, φ₀…φᵢ₋₁) `
- the sign `φsΛ.sign`
- `φsΛ.staticContract`
- `s • [anPart φ, ofFieldOp φs[k]]ₛ` where `s` is the sign associated with moving `φ` through
  uncontracted fields in `φ₀…φₖ₋₁`
- the normal ordering of `[φsΛ]ᵘᶜ` with the field operator `φs[k]` removed.

The proof of this result ultimately relies on
- `staticContract_insert_some` to rewrite static contractions.
- `normalOrder_uncontracted_some` to rewrite normal orderings.
- `sign_insert_some_zero` to rewrite signs.
declarations.statement:
lemma staticWickTerm_insert_zero_some (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (k : { x // x ∈ φsΛ.uncontracted }) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ 0 k).staticWickTerm =
    sign φs φsΛ • (↑φsΛ.staticContract *
    (contractStateAtIndex φ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ ((uncontractedFieldOpEquiv φs φsΛ) (some k)) *
    𝓝(ofFieldOpList (optionEraseZ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ φ (uncontractedFieldOpEquiv φs φsΛ k)))))

declarations.name: WickContraction.mul_staticWickTerm_eq_sum
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, the following relation
holds

`φ * φsΛ.staticWickTerm = ∑ k, (φsΛ ↩Λ φ 0 k).staticWickTerm`

where the sum is over all `k` in `Option φsΛ.uncontracted`, so `k` is either `none` or `some k`.

The proof proceeds as follows:
- `ofFieldOp_mul_normalOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_sum` is used to expand `φ 𝓝([φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)` as
  a sum over `k` in `Option φsΛ.uncontracted` of terms involving `[anPart φ, φs[k]]ₛ`.
- Then `staticWickTerm_insert_zero_none` and `staticWickTerm_insert_zero_some` are
  used to equate terms.
declarations.statement:
lemma mul_staticWickTerm_eq_sum (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    ofFieldOp φ * φsΛ.staticWickTerm =
    ∑ (k : Option φsΛ.uncontracted), (φsΛ ↩Λ φ 0 k).staticWickTerm

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.static_wick_theorem
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, the static version of Wick's theorem states that

`φs = ∑ φsΛ, φsΛ.staticWickTerm`

where the sum is over all Wick contraction `φsΛ`.

The proof is via induction on `φs`.
- The base case `φs = []` is handled by `staticWickTerm_empty_nil`.

The inductive step works as follows:

For the LHS:
1. The proof considers `φ₀…φₙ` as `φ₀(φ₁…φₙ)` and uses the induction hypothesis on `φ₁…φₙ`.
2. This gives terms of the form `φ * φsΛ.staticWickTerm` on which
  `mul_staticWickTerm_eq_sum` is used where `φsΛ` is a Wick contraction of `φ₁…φₙ`,
  to rewrite terms as a sum over optional uncontracted elements of `φsΛ`

On the LHS we now have a sum over Wick contractions `φsΛ` of `φ₁…φₙ` (from 1) and optional
uncontracted elements of `φsΛ` (from 2)

For the RHS:
1. The sum over Wick contractions of `φ₀…φₙ` on the RHS
  is split via `insertLift_sum` into a sum over Wick contractions `φsΛ` of `φ₁…φₙ` and
  sum over optional uncontracted elements of `φsΛ`.

Both sides are now sums over the same thing and their terms equate by the nature of the
lemmas used.
declarations.statement:
theorem static_wick_theorem : (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) →
    ofFieldOpList φs = ∑ (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length), φsΛ.staticWickTerm

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.superCommute
declarations.doc:
For a field specification `𝓕`, `superCommute` is the linear map

`WickAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] WickAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] WickAlgebra 𝓕`

defined as the descent of `ι ∘ superCommuteF` in both arguments.
In particular for `φs` and `φs'` lists of `𝓕.CrAnFieldOp` in `WickAlgebra 𝓕` the following
relation holds:

`superCommute φs φs' = φs * φs' - 𝓢(φs, φs') • φs' * φs`

The notation `[a, b]ₛ` is used for `superCommute a b`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def superCommute : WickAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ]
    WickAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] WickAlgebra 𝓕

declarations.statement: lemma superCommute_anPart_anPart (φ φ' : 𝓕.FieldOp) : [anPart φ, anPart φ']ₛ = 0

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.superCommute_crPart_ofFieldOpList
declarations.statement:
lemma superCommute_crPart_ofFieldOpList (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    [crPart φ, ofFieldOpList φs]ₛ = crPart φ * ofFieldOpList φs -
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs) • ofFieldOpList φs * crPart φ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.superCommute_anPart_ofFieldOpList
declarations.statement:
lemma superCommute_anPart_ofFieldOpList (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    [anPart φ, ofFieldOpList φs]ₛ = anPart φ * ofFieldOpList φs -
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs) • ofFieldOpList φs * anPart φ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.superCommute_crPart_ofFieldOp
declarations.statement:
lemma superCommute_crPart_ofFieldOp (φ φ' : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    [crPart φ, ofFieldOp φ']ₛ = crPart φ * ofFieldOp φ' -
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φ') • ofFieldOp φ' * crPart φ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.superCommute_anPart_ofFieldOp
declarations.statement:
lemma superCommute_anPart_ofFieldOp (φ φ' : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    [anPart φ, ofFieldOp φ']ₛ = anPart φ * ofFieldOp φ' -
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φ') • ofFieldOp φ' * anPart φ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ofCrAnList_mul_ofCrAnList_eq_superCommute
declarations.statement:
lemma ofCrAnList_mul_ofCrAnList_eq_superCommute (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :

    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs') • ofCrAnList φs' * ofCrAnList φs

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ofCrAnOp_mul_ofCrAnList_eq_superCommute
declarations.statement:
lemma ofCrAnOp_mul_ofCrAnList_eq_superCommute (φ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) : ofCrAnOp φ * ofCrAnList φs' =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs') • ofCrAnList φs' * ofCrAnOp φ
    + [ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnList φs']ₛ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ofFieldOpList_mul_ofFieldOpList_eq_superCommute
declarations.statement:
lemma ofFieldOpList_mul_ofFieldOpList_eq_superCommute (φs φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    ofFieldOpList φs * ofFieldOpList φs' =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs') • ofFieldOpList φs' * ofFieldOpList φs
    + [ofFieldOpList φs, ofFieldOpList φs']ₛ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ofFieldOp_mul_ofFieldOpList_eq_superCommute
declarations.statement:
lemma ofFieldOp_mul_ofFieldOpList_eq_superCommute (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOpList φs' = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs') • ofFieldOpList φs' * ofFieldOp φ
    + [ofFieldOp φ, ofFieldOpList φs']ₛ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ofFieldOp_mul_ofFieldOp_eq_superCommute
declarations.statement:
lemma ofFieldOp_mul_ofFieldOp_eq_superCommute (φ φ' : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp φ' = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φ') • ofFieldOp φ' * ofFieldOp φ
    + [ofFieldOp φ, ofFieldOp φ']ₛ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ofFieldOpList_mul_ofFieldOp_eq_superCommute
declarations.statement:
lemma ofFieldOpList_mul_ofFieldOp_eq_superCommute (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    ofFieldOpList φs * ofFieldOp φ = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ φ) • ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOpList φs
    + [ofFieldOpList φs, ofFieldOp φ]ₛ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ofCrAnList_mul_ofFieldOpList_eq_superCommute
declarations.statement:
lemma ofCrAnList_mul_ofFieldOpList_eq_superCommute (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp) : ofCrAnList φs * ofFieldOpList φs' =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs') • ofFieldOpList φs' * ofCrAnList φs
    + [ofCrAnList φs, ofFieldOpList φs']ₛ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.crPart_mul_anPart_eq_superCommute
declarations.statement:
lemma crPart_mul_anPart_eq_superCommute (φ φ' : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    crPart φ * anPart φ' = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φ') • anPart φ' * crPart φ
    + [crPart φ, anPart φ']ₛ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.anPart_mul_crPart_eq_superCommute
declarations.statement:
lemma anPart_mul_crPart_eq_superCommute (φ φ' : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    anPart φ * crPart φ' = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φ') • crPart φ' * anPart φ
    + [anPart φ, crPart φ']ₛ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.crPart_mul_crPart_swap
declarations.statement:
lemma crPart_mul_crPart_swap (φ φ' : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    crPart φ * crPart φ' = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φ') • crPart φ' * crPart φ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.anPart_mul_anPart_swap
declarations.statement:
lemma anPart_mul_anPart_swap (φ φ' : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    anPart φ * anPart φ' = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φ') • anPart φ' * anPart φ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.superCommute_ofCrAnList_ofCrAnList_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma superCommute_ofCrAnList_ofCrAnList_symm (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
    [ofCrAnList φs, ofCrAnList φs']ₛ =
    (- 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs')) • [ofCrAnList φs', ofCrAnList φs]ₛ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.superCommute_ofCrAnOp_ofCrAnOp_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma superCommute_ofCrAnOp_ofCrAnOp_symm (φ φ' : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
    [ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp φ']ₛ =
    (- 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φ')) • [ofCrAnOp φ', ofCrAnOp φ]ₛ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.superCommute_ofCrAnList_ofCrAnList_eq_sum
declarations.statement:
lemma superCommute_ofCrAnList_ofCrAnList_eq_sum (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
    [ofCrAnList φs, ofCrAnList φs']ₛ =
    ∑ (n : Fin φs'.length), 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs'.take n) •
    ofCrAnList (φs'.take n) * [ofCrAnList φs, ofCrAnOp (φs'.get n)]ₛ *
    ofCrAnList (φs'.drop (n + 1))

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.superCommute_ofCrAnOp_ofCrAnList_eq_sum
declarations.statement:
lemma superCommute_ofCrAnOp_ofCrAnList_eq_sum (φ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) : [ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnList φs']ₛ =
    ∑ (n : Fin φs'.length), 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs'.take n) •
    [ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp (φs'.get n)]ₛ * ofCrAnList (φs'.eraseIdx n)

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.superCommute_ofCrAnList_ofFieldOpList_eq_sum
declarations.statement:
lemma superCommute_ofCrAnList_ofFieldOpList_eq_sum (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp) : [ofCrAnList φs, ofFieldOpList φs']ₛ =
    ∑ (n : Fin φs'.length), 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs'.take n) •
    ofFieldOpList (φs'.take n) * [ofCrAnList φs, ofFieldOp (φs'.get n)]ₛ *
    ofFieldOpList (φs'.drop (n + 1))

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.superCommute_ofCrAnOp_ofFieldOpList_eq_sum
declarations.statement:
lemma superCommute_ofCrAnOp_ofFieldOpList_eq_sum (φ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) (φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    [ofCrAnOp φ, ofFieldOpList φs']ₛ =
    ∑ (n : Fin φs'.length), 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs'.take n) •
    [ofCrAnOp φ, ofFieldOp (φs'.get n)]ₛ * ofFieldOpList (φs'.eraseIdx n)

modules.title: Time contractions
modules.doc:
We define the state algebra of a field structure to be the free algebra
generated by the states.

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeContract
declarations.doc:
For a field specification `𝓕`, and `φ` and `ψ` elements of `𝓕.FieldOp`, the element of
`𝓕.WickAlgebra`, `timeContract φ ψ` is defined to be `𝓣(φψ) - 𝓝(φψ)`.
declarations.statement: def timeContract (φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp) : 𝓕.WickAlgebra

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeContract_eq_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_eq_smul (φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp) : timeContract φ ψ =
    𝓣(ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ) + (-1 : ℂ) • 𝓝(ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ)

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeContract_of_timeOrderRel
declarations.doc:
For a field specification `𝓕`, and `φ` and `ψ` elements of `𝓕.FieldOp`, if
`φ` and `ψ` are time-ordered then

`timeContract φ ψ = [anPart φ, ofFieldOp ψ]ₛ`.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_of_timeOrderRel (φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (h : timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    timeContract φ ψ = [anPart φ, ofFieldOp ψ]ₛ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeContract_of_not_timeOrderRel
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_of_not_timeOrderRel (φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    timeContract φ ψ = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • timeContract ψ φ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeContract_of_not_timeOrderRel_expand
declarations.doc:
For a field specification `𝓕`, and `φ` and `ψ` elements of `𝓕.FieldOp`, if
`φ` and `ψ` are not time-ordered then

`timeContract φ ψ = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • [anPart ψ, ofFieldOp φ]ₛ`.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_of_not_timeOrderRel_expand (φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    timeContract φ ψ = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • [anPart ψ, ofFieldOp φ]ₛ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeContract_eq_superCommute
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_eq_superCommute (φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    timeContract φ ψ = if timeOrderRel φ ψ then [anPart φ, ofFieldOp ψ]ₛ
    else 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • [anPart ψ, ofFieldOp φ]ₛ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeContract_mem_center
declarations.doc:
For a field specification `𝓕`, and `φ` and `ψ` elements of `𝓕.FieldOp`, then
`timeContract φ ψ` is in the center of `𝓕.WickAlgebra`.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_mem_center (φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    timeContract φ ψ ∈ Subalgebra.center ℂ 𝓕.WickAlgebra

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeContract_zero_of_diff_grade
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_zero_of_diff_grade (φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (h : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)) :
    timeContract φ ψ = 0

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.normalOrder_timeContract
declarations.statement:
lemma normalOrder_timeContract (φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    𝓝(timeContract φ ψ) = 0

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_timeContract_eq_time_mid
FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_timeContract_eq_time_left
FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_timeContract_ne_time
FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeContract_inAsymp_inAsymp
declarations.doc:
The time contraction of an incoming asymptotic field with
another incoming asymptotic field is zero.

This prevents Feynman diagrams where incoming vertices are
connected to incoming vertices.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_inAsymp_inAsymp (φ ψ : ((f : Field 𝓕) × AsymptoticLabel 𝓕 f) × Momentum) :
    timeContract (.inAsymp φ) (.inAsymp ψ) = 0

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeContract_outAsymp_outAsymp
declarations.doc:
The time contraction of an outgoing asymptotic field with
another outgoing asymptotic field is zero.

This prevents Feynman diagrams where outgoing vertices are
connected to outgoing vertices.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_outAsymp_outAsymp (φ ψ : ((f : Field 𝓕) × AsymptoticLabel 𝓕 f) × Momentum) :
    timeContract (.outAsymp φ) (.outAsymp ψ) = 0

sections.text: ## Defining time order for `FieldOpFreeAlgebra`.
## Properties of time ordering

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_eq_time_ofCrAnListF
declarations.statement:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_eq_time_ofCrAnListF {φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (φs1 φs2 : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) (h :
      crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ2 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ1 φ3 ∧
      crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ2 φ3 ∧
      crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ1 ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel φ3 φ2) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs1 * [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF *
    ofCrAnListF φs2) = 0

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF
declarations.statement:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF {φ1 φ2 φ3 : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (φs1 φs2 : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs1 * [ofCrAnOpF φ1, [ofCrAnOpF φ2, ofCrAnOpF φ3]ₛF]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs2)
    = 0

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_superCommuteF
FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
declarations.statement:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_ne_time
FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_zero_of_mem_ideal
declarations.statement:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_zero_of_mem_ideal (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra)
    (h : a ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span 𝓕.fieldOpIdealSet) : ι 𝓣ᶠ(a) = 0

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_eq_of_equiv
declarations.statement:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_eq_of_equiv (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (h : a ≈ b) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a) = ι 𝓣ᶠ(b)

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder
declarations.doc:
For a field specification `𝓕`, `timeOrder` is the linear map

`WickAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] WickAlgebra 𝓕`

defined as the descent of `ι ∘ₗ timeOrderF : FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] WickAlgebra 𝓕` from
`FieldOpFreeAlgebra 𝓕` to `WickAlgebra 𝓕`.
This descent exists because `ι ∘ₗ timeOrderF` is well-defined on equivalence classes.

The notation `𝓣(a)` is used for `timeOrder a`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def timeOrder : WickAlgebra 𝓕 →ₗ[ℂ] WickAlgebra 𝓕

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_eq_ι_timeOrderF (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    𝓣(ι a) = ι 𝓣ᶠ(a)

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_ordered
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    𝓣(ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ) = ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_not_ordered
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_not_ordered {φ ψ : 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : ¬ timeOrderRel φ ψ) :
    𝓣(ofFieldOp φ * ofFieldOp ψ) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • ofFieldOp ψ * ofFieldOp φ

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_ofFieldOp_ofFieldOp_not_ordered_eq_timeOrder
FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_nil
declarations.statement: lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_nil : 𝓣(ofFieldOpList (𝓕 := 𝓕) []) = 1

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_singleton
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_singleton (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    𝓣(ofFieldOpList [φ]) = ofFieldOpList [φ]

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_eq_maxTimeField_mul_finset
declarations.doc:
For a field specification `𝓕`, the time order operator acting on a
list of `𝓕.FieldOp`, `𝓣(φ₀…φₙ)`, is equal to
`𝓢(φᵢ,φ₀…φᵢ₋₁) • φᵢ * 𝓣(φ₀…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁φₙ)` where `φᵢ` is the maximal time field
operator in `φ₀…φₙ`.

The proof of this result ultimately relies on basic properties of ordering and signs.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_eq_maxTimeField_mul_finset (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    𝓣(ofFieldOpList (φ :: φs)) = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ maxTimeField φ φs, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨(eraseMaxTimeField φ φs).get,
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x =>
        (maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs).succAbove x < maxTimeFieldPosFin φ φs))⟩) •
      ofFieldOp (maxTimeField φ φs) * 𝓣(ofFieldOpList (eraseMaxTimeField φ φs))

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_superCommute_eq_time_mid
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_superCommute_eq_time_mid {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣(a * [ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ * b) =
    [ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ * 𝓣(a * b)

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_superCommute_eq_time_left
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_superCommute_eq_time_left {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (b : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣([ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ * b) =
    [ofCrAnOp φ, ofCrAnOp ψ]ₛ * 𝓣(b)

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_superCommute_ne_time
FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_superCommute_anPart_ofFieldOp_ne_time
FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_timeOrder_mid
declarations.doc:
For a field specification `𝓕`, and `a`, `b`, `c` in `𝓕.WickAlgebra`, then
`𝓣(a * b * c) = 𝓣(a * 𝓣(b) * c)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_timeOrder_mid (a b c : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣(a * b * c) = 𝓣(a * 𝓣(b) * c)

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_timeOrder_left
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_timeOrder_left (b c : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣(b * c) = 𝓣(𝓣(b) * c)

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_timeOrder_right
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_timeOrder_right (a b : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣(a * b) = 𝓣(a * 𝓣(b))

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_timeOrder
declarations.doc: Time ordering is a projection.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_timeOrder (a : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣(𝓣(a)) = 𝓣(a)

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.universalLiftMap
declarations.doc:
For a field specification, `𝓕`, given an algebra `A` and a function `f : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp → A`
such that the lift of `f` to `FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ f : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp → A` is
zero on the ideal defining `𝓕.WickAlgebra`, the corresponding map `𝓕.WickAlgebra → A`.

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.universalLiftMap_ι
declarations.statement:
lemma universalLiftMap_ι {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (f : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp → A)
    (h1 : ∀ a ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span 𝓕.fieldOpIdealSet, FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ f a = 0) :
    universalLiftMap f h1 (ι a) = FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ f a

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.universalLift
declarations.doc:
For a field specification, `𝓕`, given an algebra `A` and a function `f : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp → A`
such that the lift of `f` to `FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ f : FreeAlgebra ℂ 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp → A` is
zero on the ideal defining `𝓕.WickAlgebra`, the corresponding algebra map
`𝓕.WickAlgebra → A`.

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.universalLift_ι
declarations.statement:
lemma universalLift_ι {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (f : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp → A)
    (h1 : ∀ a ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span 𝓕.fieldOpIdealSet, FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ f a = 0) :
    universalLift f h1 (ι a) = FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ f a

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.universality
declarations.doc:
For a field specification, `𝓕`, the algebra `𝓕.WickAlgebra` satisfies the following universal
property. Let `f : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp → A` be a function and `g : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra →ₐ[ℂ] A`
the universal lift of that function associated with the free algebra `𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra`.
If `g` is zero on the ideal defining `𝓕.WickAlgebra`, then there exists
algebra map `g' : WickAlgebra 𝓕 →ₐ[ℂ] A` such that `g' ∘ ι = g`, and furthermore this
algebra map is unique.
declarations.statement:
lemma universality {A : Type} [Semiring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (f : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp → A)
    (h1 : ∀ a ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span 𝓕.fieldOpIdealSet, FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ f a = 0) :
    ∃! g : WickAlgebra 𝓕 →ₐ[ℂ] A, g ∘ ι = FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ f

modules.title: Wick's theorem
modules.doc:
This file constrains the time-dependent version of Wick's theorem
for lists of fields containing both fermions and bosons.

Wick's theorem is related to Isserlis' theorem in mathematics.

sections.text: ## Wick terms
## Wick's theorem

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.wicks_theorem_congr
declarations.statement:
lemma wicks_theorem_congr {φs φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : φs = φs') :
    ∑ (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length), φsΛ.wickTerm
    = ∑ (φs'Λ : WickContraction φs'.length), φs'Λ.wickTerm

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.wicks_theorem
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, Wick's theorem states that

`𝓣(φs) = ∑ φsΛ, φsΛ.wickTerm`

where the sum is over all Wick contraction `φsΛ`.

The proof is via induction on `φs`.
- The base case `φs = []` is handled by `wickTerm_empty_nil`.

The inductive step works as follows:

For the LHS:
1. `timeOrder_eq_maxTimeField_mul_finset` is used to write
  `𝓣(φ₀…φₙ)` as `𝓢(φᵢ,φ₀…φᵢ₋₁) • φᵢ * 𝓣(φ₀…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁φₙ)` where `φᵢ` is
  the maximal time field in `φ₀…φₙ`
2. The induction hypothesis is then used on `𝓣(φ₀…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁φₙ)` to expand it as a sum over
  Wick contractions of `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁φₙ`.
3. This gives terms of the form `φᵢ * φsΛ.wickTerm` on which
  `mul_wickTerm_eq_sum` is used where `φsΛ` is a Wick contraction of `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁φ`,
  to rewrite terms as a sum over optional uncontracted elements of `φsΛ`

On the LHS we now have a sum over Wick contractions `φsΛ` of `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁φ` (from 2) and optional
uncontracted elements of `φsΛ` (from 3)

For the RHS:
1. The sum over Wick contractions of `φ₀…φₙ` on the RHS
  is split via `insertLift_sum` into a sum over Wick contractions `φsΛ` of `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁φᵢ₊₁φ` and
  sum over optional uncontracted elements of `φsΛ`.

Both sides are now sums over the same thing and their terms equate by the nature of the
lemmas used.
declarations.statement:
theorem wicks_theorem : (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) → 𝓣(ofFieldOpList φs) =
    ∑ (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length), φsΛ.wickTerm

modules.title: Wick's theorem for normal ordered lists

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_eqTimeOnly
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, then

`𝓣(φs) = ∑ φsΛ, φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract * 𝓣(𝓝([φsΛ]ᵘᶜ))`

where the sum is over all Wick contraction `φsΛ` which only have equal time contractions.

This result follows from
- `static_wick_theorem` to rewrite `𝓣(φs)` on the left hand side as a sum of
  `𝓣(φsΛ.staticWickTerm)`.
- `EqTimeOnly.timeOrder_staticContract_of_not_mem` and `timeOrder_timeOrder_mid` to set to
  those `𝓣(φsΛ.staticWickTerm)` for which `φsΛ` has a contracted pair which are not
  equal time to zero.
- `staticContract_eq_timeContract_of_eqTimeOnly` to rewrite the static contract
  in the remaining `𝓣(φsΛ.staticWickTerm)` as a time contract.
- `timeOrder_timeContract_mul_of_eqTimeOnly_left` to move the time contracts out of the time
  ordering.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_eqTimeOnly (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    𝓣(ofFieldOpList φs) = ∑ (φsΛ : {φsΛ // φsΛ.EqTimeOnly (φs := φs)}),
    φsΛ.1.sign • φsΛ.1.timeContract.1 * 𝓣(𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ.1]ᵘᶜ))

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_eqTimeOnly_empty
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_eqTimeOnly_empty (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    𝓣(ofFieldOpList φs) = 𝓣(𝓝(ofFieldOpList φs)) +
    ∑ (φsΛ : {φsΛ // φsΛ.EqTimeOnly (φs := φs) ∧ φsΛ ≠ empty}),
    φsΛ.1.sign • φsΛ.1.timeContract.1 * 𝓣(𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ.1]ᵘᶜ))

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.normalOrder_timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_eqTimeOnly_empty
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, then

`𝓣(𝓝(φs)) = 𝓣(φs) - ∑ φsΛ, φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract.1 * 𝓣(𝓝([φsΛ]ᵘᶜ))`

where the sum is over all *non-empty* Wick contraction `φsΛ` which only
  have equal time contractions.

This result follows directly from
- `timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_eqTimeOnly`
declarations.statement:
lemma normalOrder_timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_eqTimeOnly_empty (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    𝓣(𝓝(ofFieldOpList φs)) = 𝓣(ofFieldOpList φs) -
    ∑ (φsΛ : {φsΛ // φsΛ.EqTimeOnly (φs := φs) ∧ φsΛ ≠ empty}),
    φsΛ.1.sign • φsΛ.1.timeContract.1 * 𝓣(𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ.1]ᵘᶜ))

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.timeOrder_haveEqTime_split
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, then `𝓣(φs)` is equal to the sum of

- `∑ φsΛ, φsΛ.wickTerm` where the sum is over all Wick contraction `φsΛ` which have
  no contractions of equal time.
- `∑ φsΛ, φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract * (∑ φssucΛ, φssucΛ.wickTerm)`, where
  the first sum is over all Wick contraction `φsΛ` which only have equal time contractions
  and the second sum is over all Wick contraction `φssucΛ` of the uncontracted elements of `φsΛ`
  which do not have any equal time contractions.

The proof proceeds as follows
- `wicks_theorem` is used to rewrite `𝓣(φs)` as a sum over all Wick contractions.
- The sum over all Wick contractions is then split additively into two parts based on having
  or not having an equal time contractions.
- Using `join`, the sum `∑ φsΛ, _` over Wick contractions which do have equal time contractions
  is split into two sums `∑ φsΛ, ∑ φsucΛ, _`, the first over non-zero elements
  which only have equal time contractions and the second over Wick contractions `φsucΛ` of
  `[φsΛ]ᵘᶜ` which do not have equal time contractions.
- `join_sign_timeContract` is then used to equate terms.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_haveEqTime_split (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    𝓣(ofFieldOpList φs) = (∑ (φsΛ : {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length // ¬ HaveEqTime φsΛ}),
    φsΛ.1.sign • φsΛ.1.timeContract.1 * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ.1]ᵘᶜ))
    + ∑ (φsΛ : {φsΛ // φsΛ.EqTimeOnly (φs := φs) ∧ φsΛ ≠ empty}), φsΛ.1.sign • φsΛ.1.timeContract *
    (∑ φssucΛ : { φssucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ.1]ᵘᶜ.length // ¬ φssucΛ.HaveEqTime },
      φssucΛ.1.wickTerm)

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.normalOrder_timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_not_haveEqTime_sub_inductive
declarations.statement:
lemma normalOrder_timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_not_haveEqTime_sub_inductive (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    𝓣(𝓝(ofFieldOpList φs)) =
      (∑ (φsΛ : {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length // ¬ HaveEqTime φsΛ}), φsΛ.1.wickTerm)
      + ∑ (φsΛ : {φsΛ // φsΛ.EqTimeOnly (φs := φs) ∧ φsΛ ≠ empty}),
        sign φs ↑φsΛ • (φsΛ.1).timeContract *
        (∑ φssucΛ : { φssucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ.1]ᵘᶜ.length // ¬ φssucΛ.HaveEqTime },
        φssucΛ.1.wickTerm - 𝓣(𝓝(ofFieldOpList [φsΛ.1]ᵘᶜ)))

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.wicks_theorem_normal_order_empty
declarations.statement:
lemma wicks_theorem_normal_order_empty : 𝓣(𝓝(ofFieldOpList [])) =
    ∑ (φsΛ : {φsΛ : WickContraction ([] : List 𝓕.FieldOp).length // ¬ HaveEqTime φsΛ}),
    φsΛ.1.wickTerm

declarations.name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.wicks_theorem_normal_order
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, the normal-ordered version of Wick's theorem states that

`𝓣(𝓝(φs)) = ∑ φsΛ, φsΛ.wickTerm`

where the sum is over all Wick contraction `φsΛ` in which no two contracted elements
have the same time.

The proof proceeds by induction on `φs`, with the base case `[]` holding by following
through definitions. and the inductive case holding as a result of
- `timeOrder_haveEqTime_split`
- `normalOrder_timeOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_eqTimeOnly_empty`
- and the induction hypothesis on `𝓣(𝓝([φsΛ.1]ᵘᶜ))` for contractions `φsΛ` of `φs` which only
  have equal time contractions and are non-empty.
declarations.statement:
theorem wicks_theorem_normal_order : (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) →
    𝓣(𝓝(ofFieldOpList φs)) =
    ∑ (φsΛ : {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length // ¬ HaveEqTime φsΛ}), φsΛ.1.wickTerm

declarations.name: WickContraction.wickTerm
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, and a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, the element
of `𝓕.WickAlgebra`, `φsΛ.wickTerm` is defined as

`φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract * 𝓝([φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)`.

This is a term which appears in the Wick's theorem.
declarations.statement: def wickTerm {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) : 𝓕.WickAlgebra

declarations.name: WickContraction.wickTerm_empty_nil
declarations.doc:
For the empty list `[]` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, the `wickTerm` of the Wick contraction
corresponding to the empty set `∅` (the only Wick contraction of `[]`) is `1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma wickTerm_empty_nil :
    wickTerm (empty (n := ([] : List 𝓕.FieldOp).length)) = 1

declarations.name: WickContraction.wickTerm_insert_none
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
  `𝓕.FieldOp`, and `i ≤ φs.length`, then `(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).wickTerm` is equal to

`𝓢(φ, φ₀…φᵢ₋₁) φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract * 𝓝(φ :: [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)`

The proof of this result relies on
- `normalOrder_uncontracted_none` to rewrite normal orderings.
- `timeContract_insert_none` to rewrite the time contract.
- `sign_insert_none` to rewrite the sign.
declarations.statement:
lemma wickTerm_insert_none (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).wickTerm =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => i.succAbove k < i))⟩)
    • (φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList (φ :: [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)))

declarations.name: WickContraction.wickTerm_insert_some
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
  `𝓕.FieldOp`, `i ≤ φs.length` and a `k` in `φsΛ.uncontracted`,
  such that all `𝓕.FieldOp` in `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁` have time strictly less than `φ` and
  `φ` has a time greater than or equal to all `FieldOp` in `φ₀…φₙ`, then
  `(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).staticWickTerm`
is equal to the product of
- the sign `𝓢(φ, φ₀…φᵢ₋₁) `
- the sign `φsΛ.sign`
- `φsΛ.timeContract`
- `s • [anPart φ, ofFieldOp φs[k]]ₛ` where `s` is the sign associated with moving `φ` through
  uncontracted fields in `φ₀…φₖ₋₁`
- the normal ordering `[φsΛ]ᵘᶜ` with the field corresponding to `k` removed.

The proof of this result relies on
- `timeContract_insert_some_of_not_lt`
  and `timeContract_insert_some_of_lt` to rewrite time
  contractions.
- `normalOrder_uncontracted_some` to rewrite normal orderings.
- `sign_insert_some_of_not_lt` and `sign_insert_some_of_lt` to rewrite signs.
declarations.statement:
lemma wickTerm_insert_some (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (hlt : ∀ (k : Fin φs.length), timeOrderRel φ φs[k])
    (hn : ∀ (k : Fin φs.length), i.succAbove k < i → ¬ timeOrderRel φs[k] φ) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).wickTerm =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => i.succAbove x < i))⟩)
    • (φsΛ.sign • (contractStateAtIndex φ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ
      ((uncontractedFieldOpEquiv φs φsΛ) (some k)) * φsΛ.timeContract)
    * 𝓝(ofFieldOpList (optionEraseZ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ φ (uncontractedFieldOpEquiv φs φsΛ k))))

declarations.name: WickContraction.mul_wickTerm_eq_sum
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
  `𝓕.FieldOp`, and `i ≤ φs.length`
  such that all `𝓕.FieldOp` in `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁` have time strictly less than `φ` and
  `φ` has a time greater than or equal to all `FieldOp` in `φ₀…φₙ`, then

`φ * φsΛ.wickTerm = 𝓢(φ, φ₀…φᵢ₋₁) • ∑ k, (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i k).wickTerm`

where the sum is over all `k` in `Option φsΛ.uncontracted`, so `k` is either `none` or `some k`.

The proof proceeds as follows:
- `ofFieldOp_mul_normalOrder_ofFieldOpList_eq_sum` is used to expand `φ 𝓝([φsΛ]ᵘᶜ)` as
  a sum over `k` in `Option φsΛ.uncontracted` of terms involving `[anPart φ, φs[k]]ₛ`.
- Then `wickTerm_insert_none` and `wickTerm_insert_some` are used to equate terms.
declarations.statement:
lemma mul_wickTerm_eq_sum (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (i : Fin φs.length.succ)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (hlt : ∀ (k : Fin φs.length), timeOrderRel φ φs[k])
    (hn : ∀ (k : Fin φs.length), i.succAbove k < i → ¬timeOrderRel φs[k] φ) :
    ofFieldOp φ * φsΛ.wickTerm =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => i.succAbove x < i))⟩) •
    ∑ (k : Option φsΛ.uncontracted), (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i k).wickTerm

sections.text: ## Extracting parts from a contraction.

declarations.name: WickContraction
declarations.doc:
Given a natural number `n`, which will correspond to the number of fields needing
contracting, a Wick contraction
is a finite set of pairs of `Fin n` (numbers `0`, ..., `n-1`), such that no
element of `Fin n` occurs in more than one pair. The pairs are the positions of fields we
'contract' together.
declarations.statement: def WickContraction (n : ℕ) : Type

declarations.doc: Wick contractions are decidable.
declarations.statement: instance : DecidableEq (WickContraction n)

declarations.name: WickContraction.empty
declarations.doc: The contraction consisting of no contracted pairs.
declarations.statement: def empty : WickContraction n

declarations.name: WickContraction.card_zero_iff_empty
declarations.statement: lemma card_zero_iff_empty (c : WickContraction n) : c.1.card = 0 ↔ c = empty

declarations.name: WickContraction.exists_pair_of_not_eq_empty
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_pair_of_not_eq_empty (c : WickContraction n) (h : c ≠ empty) :
    ∃ i j, {i, j} ∈ c.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.congr
declarations.doc:
The equivalence between `WickContraction n` and `WickContraction m`
derived from a propositional equality of `n` and `m`.
declarations.statement: def congr : {n m : ℕ} → (h : n = m) → WickContraction n ≃ WickContraction m

declarations.name: WickContraction.congr_refl
declarations.statement: lemma congr_refl : c.congr rfl = c

declarations.name: WickContraction.card_congr
declarations.statement:
lemma card_congr {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (c : WickContraction n) :
    (congr h c).1.card = c.1.card

declarations.name: WickContraction.congr_contractions
declarations.statement:
lemma congr_contractions {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (c : WickContraction n) :
    ((congr h) c).1 = Finset.map (Finset.mapEmbedding (finCongr h)).toEmbedding c.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.congr_trans
declarations.statement:
lemma congr_trans {n m o : ℕ} (h1 : n = m) (h2 : m = o) :
    (congr h1).trans (congr h2) = congr (h1.trans h2)

declarations.name: WickContraction.congr_trans_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma congr_trans_apply {n m o : ℕ} (h1 : n = m) (h2 : m = o) (c : WickContraction n) :
    (congr h2) ((congr h1) c) = congr (h1.trans h2) c

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_congr_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_congr_iff {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) {c : WickContraction n } {a : Finset (Fin m)} :
    a ∈ (congr h c).1 ↔ Finset.map (finCongr h.symm).toEmbedding a ∈ c.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.congrLift
declarations.doc:
Given a contracted pair in `c : WickContraction n` the contracted pair
in `congr h c`.
declarations.statement: def congrLift {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) {c : WickContraction n} (a : c.1) : (congr h c).1

declarations.name: WickContraction.congrLift_rfl
declarations.statement:
lemma congrLift_rfl {n : ℕ} {c : WickContraction n} :
    c.congrLift rfl = id

declarations.name: WickContraction.congrLift_injective
declarations.statement:
lemma congrLift_injective {n m : ℕ} {c : WickContraction n} (h : n = m) :
    Function.Injective (c.congrLift h)

declarations.name: WickContraction.congrLift_surjective
declarations.statement:
lemma congrLift_surjective {n m : ℕ} {c : WickContraction n} (h : n = m) :
    Function.Surjective (c.congrLift h)

declarations.name: WickContraction.congrLift_bijective
declarations.statement:
lemma congrLift_bijective {n m : ℕ} {c : WickContraction n} (h : n = m) :
    Function.Bijective (c.congrLift h)

declarations.name: WickContraction.congrLiftInv
declarations.doc:
Given a contracted pair in `c : WickContraction n` the contracted pair
in `congr h c`.
declarations.statement: def congrLiftInv {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) {c : WickContraction n} (a : (congr h c).1) : c.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.congrLiftInv_rfl
declarations.statement:
lemma congrLiftInv_rfl {n : ℕ} {c : WickContraction n} :
    c.congrLiftInv rfl = id

declarations.name: WickContraction.eq_filter_mem_self
declarations.statement: lemma eq_filter_mem_self : c.1 = Finset.filter (fun x => x ∈ c.1) Finset.univ

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?
declarations.doc:
For a contraction `c : WickContraction n` and `i : Fin n` the `j` such that
`{i, j}` is a contracted pair in `c`. If such an `j` does not exist, this returns `none`.
declarations.statement: def getDual? (i : Fin n) : Option (Fin n)

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_congr
declarations.statement:
lemma getDual?_congr {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin m) :
    (congr h c).getDual? i = Option.map (finCongr h) (c.getDual? (finCongr h.symm i))

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_congr_get
declarations.statement:
lemma getDual?_congr_get {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin m)
    (hg : ((congr h c).getDual? i).isSome) :
    ((congr h c).getDual? i).get hg =
    (finCongr h ((c.getDual? (finCongr h.symm i)).get (by simpa [getDual?_congr] using hg)))

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_eq_some_iff_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma getDual?_eq_some_iff_mem (i j : Fin n) :
    c.getDual? i = some j ↔ {i, j} ∈ c.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_one_eq_none
declarations.statement: lemma getDual?_one_eq_none (c : WickContraction 1) (i : Fin 1) : c.getDual? i = none

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_get_self_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma getDual?_get_self_mem (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    {(c.getDual? i).get h, i} ∈ c.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.self_getDual?_get_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma self_getDual?_get_mem (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    {i, (c.getDual? i).get h} ∈ c.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_eq_some_neq
declarations.statement:
lemma getDual?_eq_some_neq (i j : Fin n) (h : c.getDual? i = some j) :
    ¬ i = j

declarations.name: WickContraction.self_ne_getDual?_get
declarations.statement:
lemma self_ne_getDual?_get (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    ¬ i = (c.getDual? i).get h

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_get_self_neq
declarations.statement:
lemma getDual?_get_self_neq (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    ¬ (c.getDual? i).get h = i

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_isSome_iff
declarations.statement: lemma getDual?_isSome_iff (i : Fin n) : (c.getDual? i).isSome ↔ ∃ (a : c.1), i ∈ a.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_isSome_of_mem
declarations.statement: lemma getDual?_isSome_of_mem (a : c.1) (i : a.1) : (c.getDual? i).isSome

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_getDual?_get_get
declarations.statement:
lemma getDual?_getDual?_get_get (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    c.getDual? ((c.getDual? i).get h) = some i

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_getDual?_get_isSome
declarations.statement:
lemma getDual?_getDual?_get_isSome (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    (c.getDual? ((c.getDual? i).get h)).isSome

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_getDual?_get_not_none
declarations.statement:
lemma getDual?_getDual?_get_not_none (i : Fin n) (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) :
    ¬ (c.getDual? ((c.getDual? i).get h)) = none

declarations.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract
declarations.doc: The smallest of the two positions in a contracted pair given a Wick contraction.
declarations.statement: def fstFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) : Fin n

declarations.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_congr
declarations.statement:
lemma fstFieldOfContract_congr {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    (congr h c).fstFieldOfContract (c.congrLift h a) = (finCongr h) (c.fstFieldOfContract a)

declarations.name: WickContraction.sndFieldOfContract
declarations.doc: The largest of the two positions in a contracted pair given a Wick contraction.
declarations.statement: def sndFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) : Fin n

declarations.name: WickContraction.sndFieldOfContract_congr
declarations.statement:
lemma sndFieldOfContract_congr {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    (congr h c).sndFieldOfContract (c.congrLift h a) = (finCongr h) (c.sndFieldOfContract a)

declarations.name: WickContraction.finset_eq_fstFieldOfContract_sndFieldOfContract
declarations.statement:
lemma finset_eq_fstFieldOfContract_sndFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    a.1 = {c.fstFieldOfContract a, c.sndFieldOfContract a}

declarations.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_ne_sndFieldOfContract
declarations.statement:
lemma fstFieldOfContract_ne_sndFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.fstFieldOfContract a ≠ c.sndFieldOfContract a

declarations.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_le_sndFieldOfContract
declarations.statement:
lemma fstFieldOfContract_le_sndFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.fstFieldOfContract a ≤ c.sndFieldOfContract a

declarations.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_lt_sndFieldOfContract
declarations.statement:
lemma fstFieldOfContract_lt_sndFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.fstFieldOfContract a < c.sndFieldOfContract a

declarations.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma fstFieldOfContract_mem (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.fstFieldOfContract a ∈ a.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_getDual?_isSome
declarations.statement:
lemma fstFieldOfContract_getDual?_isSome (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    (c.getDual? (c.fstFieldOfContract a)).isSome

declarations.name: WickContraction.fstFieldOfContract_getDual?
declarations.statement:
lemma fstFieldOfContract_getDual? (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.getDual? (c.fstFieldOfContract a) = some (c.sndFieldOfContract a)

declarations.name: WickContraction.sndFieldOfContract_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma sndFieldOfContract_mem (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.sndFieldOfContract a ∈ a.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.sndFieldOfContract_getDual?_isSome
declarations.statement:
lemma sndFieldOfContract_getDual?_isSome (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    (c.getDual? (c.sndFieldOfContract a)).isSome

declarations.name: WickContraction.sndFieldOfContract_getDual?
declarations.statement:
lemma sndFieldOfContract_getDual? (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    c.getDual? (c.sndFieldOfContract a) = some (c.fstFieldOfContract a)

declarations.name: WickContraction.eq_fstFieldOfContract_of_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_fstFieldOfContract_of_mem (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) (i j : Fin n)
    (hi : i ∈ a.1) (hj : j ∈ a.1) (hij : i < j) :
    c.fstFieldOfContract a = i

declarations.name: WickContraction.eq_sndFieldOfContract_of_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_sndFieldOfContract_of_mem (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) (i j : Fin n)
    (hi : i ∈ a.1) (hj : j ∈ a.1) (hij : i < j) :
    c.sndFieldOfContract a = j

declarations.name: WickContraction.contractEquivFinTwo
declarations.doc:
As a type, any pair of contractions is equivalent to `Fin 2`
with `0` being associated with `c.fstFieldOfContract a` and `1` being associated with
`c.sndFieldOfContract`.
declarations.statement:
def contractEquivFinTwo (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1) :
    a ≃ Fin 2

declarations.name: WickContraction.prod_finset_eq_mul_fst_snd
declarations.statement:
lemma prod_finset_eq_mul_fst_snd (c : WickContraction n) (a : c.1)
    (f : a.1 → M) [CommMonoid M] :
    ∏ (x : a), f x = f (⟨c.fstFieldOfContract a, fstFieldOfContract_mem c a⟩)
    * f (⟨c.sndFieldOfContract a, sndFieldOfContract_mem c a⟩)

declarations.name: WickContraction.GradingCompliant
declarations.doc:
For a field specification `𝓕`, `φs` a list of `𝓕.FieldOp` and a Wick contraction
`φsΛ` of `φs`, the Wick contraction `φsΛ` is said to be `GradingCompliant` if
for every pair in `φsΛ` the contracted fields are either both `fermionic` or both `bosonic`.
In other words, in a `GradingCompliant` Wick contraction if
no contracted pairs occur between `fermionic` and `bosonic` fields.
declarations.statement: def GradingCompliant (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)

declarations.name: WickContraction.gradingCompliant_congr
declarations.statement:
lemma gradingCompliant_congr {φs φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : φs = φs')
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    GradingCompliant φs φsΛ ↔ GradingCompliant φs' (congr (by simp [h]) φsΛ)

declarations.name: WickContraction.sigmaContractedEquiv
declarations.doc:
An equivalence from the sigma type `(a : c.1) × a` to the subtype of `Fin n` consisting of
those positions which are contracted.
declarations.statement: def sigmaContractedEquiv : (a : c.1) × a ≃ {x : Fin n // (c.getDual? x).isSome}

declarations.name: WickContraction.wickContraction_card_eq_sum_zero_none_isSome
WickContraction.wickContraction_zero_none_card
declarations.statement:
lemma wickContraction_zero_none_card :
    Fintype.card {c : WickContraction n.succ // ¬ (c.getDual? 0).isSome} =
    Fintype.card (WickContraction n)

declarations.name: WickContraction.wickContraction_zero_some_eq_sum
declarations.statement:
lemma wickContraction_zero_some_eq_sum :
    Fintype.card {c : WickContraction n.succ // (c.getDual? 0).isSome} =
    ∑ i, Fintype.card {c : WickContraction n.succ // (c.getDual? 0).isSome ∧
      ∀ (h : (c.getDual? 0).isSome), (c.getDual? 0).get h = Fin.succ i}

declarations.name: WickContraction.finset_succAbove_succ_disjoint
declarations.statement:
lemma finset_succAbove_succ_disjoint (a : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    Disjoint ((Finset.map (Fin.succEmb (n + 1))) ((Finset.map i.succAboveEmb) a)) {0, i.succ}

declarations.name: WickContraction.consAddContract
declarations.doc:
The Wick contraction in `WickContraction n.succ.succ` formed by a Wick contraction
`WickContraction n` by inserting at the `0` and `i.succ` and contracting these two.
declarations.statement:
def consAddContract (i : Fin n.succ) (c : WickContraction n) :
    WickContraction n.succ.succ

declarations.name: WickContraction.consAddContract_getDual?_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma consAddContract_getDual?_zero (i : Fin n.succ) (c : WickContraction n) :
    (consAddContract i c).getDual? 0 = some i.succ

declarations.name: WickContraction.consAddContract_getDual?_self_succ
declarations.statement:
lemma consAddContract_getDual?_self_succ (i : Fin n.succ) (c : WickContraction n) :
    (consAddContract i c).getDual? i.succ = some 0

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_consAddContract_of_mem_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_consAddContract_of_mem_iff (i : Fin n.succ) (c : WickContraction n) (a : Finset (Fin n)) :
    a ∈ c.1 ↔ (a.map i.succAboveEmb).map (Fin.succEmb n.succ) ∈ (consAddContract i c).1

declarations.name: WickContraction.consAddContract_injective
declarations.statement: lemma consAddContract_injective (i : Fin n.succ) : Function.Injective (consAddContract i)

declarations.name: WickContraction.consAddContract_surjective_on_zero_contract
declarations.statement:
lemma consAddContract_surjective_on_zero_contract (i : Fin n.succ)
    (c : WickContraction n.succ.succ)
    (h : (c.getDual? 0).isSome) (h2 : (c.getDual? 0).get h = i.succ) :
    ∃ c', consAddContract i c' = c

declarations.name: WickContraction.consAddContract_bijection
declarations.statement:
lemma consAddContract_bijection (i : Fin n.succ) :
    Function.Bijective (fun c => (⟨(consAddContract i c), by simp⟩ :
    {c : WickContraction n.succ.succ // (c.getDual? 0).isSome ∧
      ∀ (h : (c.getDual? 0).isSome), (c.getDual? 0).get h = Fin.succ i}))

declarations.name: WickContraction.wickContraction_zero_some_eq_mul
declarations.statement:
lemma wickContraction_zero_some_eq_mul :
    Fintype.card {c : WickContraction n.succ.succ // (c.getDual? 0).isSome} =
    (n + 1) * Fintype.card (WickContraction n)

declarations.name: WickContraction.cardFun
declarations.doc:
The cardinality of Wick's contractions as a recursive formula.
This corresponds to OEIS:A000085.
declarations.statement: def cardFun : ℕ → ℕ

declarations.name: WickContraction.card_eq_cardFun
declarations.doc:
The number of Wick contractions in `WickContraction n` is equal to the terms in
Online Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS) A000085. That is:
1, 1, 2, 4, 10, 26, 76, 232, 764, 2620, 9496, ...
declarations.statement: theorem card_eq_cardFun : (n : ℕ) → Fintype.card (WickContraction n) = cardFun n

modules.title: Erasing an element from a contraction

declarations.name: WickContraction.erase
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick contraction `WickContraction n.succ` and a `i : Fin n.succ` the
Wick contraction associated with `n` obtained by removing `i`.
If `i` is contracted with `j` in the new Wick contraction `j` will be uncontracted.
declarations.statement: def erase (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ) : WickContraction n

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_erase_uncontracted_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_erase_uncontracted_iff (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ) (j : Fin n) :
    j ∈ (c.erase i).uncontracted ↔
    i.succAbove j ∈ c.uncontracted ∨ c.getDual? (i.succAbove j) = some i

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_not_eq_erase_of_isSome
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_not_eq_erase_of_isSome (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (h : (c.getDual? i).isSome) (ha : a ∈ c.1) (ha2 : a ≠ {i, (c.getDual? i).get h}) :
    ∃ a', a' ∈ (c.erase i).1 ∧ a = Finset.map i.succAboveEmb a'

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_not_eq_erase_of_isNone
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_not_eq_erase_of_isNone (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (h : (c.getDual? i).isNone) (ha : a ∈ c.1) :
    ∃ a', a' ∈ (c.erase i).1 ∧ a = Finset.map i.succAboveEmb a'

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDualErase
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick contraction `c : WickContraction n.succ` and a `i : Fin n.succ` the (optional)
element of `(erase c i).uncontracted` which comes from the element in `c` contracted
with `i`.
declarations.statement:
def getDualErase {n : ℕ} (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    Option ((erase c i).uncontracted)

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDualErase_isSome_iff_getDual?_isSome
declarations.statement:
lemma getDualErase_isSome_iff_getDual?_isSome (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (c.getDualErase i).isSome ↔ (c.getDual? i).isSome

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDualErase_one
declarations.statement:
lemma getDualErase_one (c : WickContraction 1) (i : Fin 1) :
    c.getDualErase i = none

declarations.name: WickContraction.extractEquiv_equiv
declarations.statement:
lemma extractEquiv_equiv {c1 c2 : (c : WickContraction n) × Option c.uncontracted}
    (h : c1.1 = c2.1) (ho : c1.2 = uncontractedCongr (by rw [h]) c2.2) : c1 = c2

declarations.name: WickContraction.extractEquiv
declarations.doc:
The equivalence between `WickContraction n.succ` and the sigma type
`(c : WickContraction n) × Option c.uncontracted` formed by inserting
and erasing elements from a contraction.
declarations.statement:
def extractEquiv (i : Fin n.succ) : WickContraction n.succ ≃
    (c : WickContraction n) × Option c.uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.extractEquiv_symm_none_uncontracted
declarations.statement:
lemma extractEquiv_symm_none_uncontracted (i : Fin n.succ) (c : WickContraction n) :
    ((extractEquiv i).symm ⟨c, none⟩).uncontracted =
    (Insert.insert i (c.uncontracted.map i.succAboveEmb))

declarations.name: WickContraction.extractEquiv_apply_congr_symm_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma extractEquiv_apply_congr_symm_apply {n m : ℕ} (k : ℕ)
    (hnk : k < n.succ) (hkm : k < m.succ) (hnm : n = m) (c : WickContraction n)
    (i : c.uncontracted) : congr (by rw [hnm]) ((extractEquiv ⟨k, hkm⟩
    (congr (by rw [hnm]) ((extractEquiv ⟨k, hnk⟩).symm ⟨c, i⟩)))).1 = c

declarations.name: WickContraction.fintypeZero
declarations.doc:
The fintype instance of `WickContraction 0` defined through its single
element `empty`.
declarations.statement: instance fintypeZero : Fintype (WickContraction 0)

declarations.name: WickContraction.sum_WickContraction_nil
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_WickContraction_nil (f : WickContraction 0 → M) [AddCommMonoid M] :
    ∑ c, f c = f empty

declarations.name: WickContraction.fintypeSucc
declarations.doc:
The fintype instance of `WickContraction n`, for `n.succ` this is defined
through the equivalence `extractEquiv`.
declarations.statement: instance fintypeSucc : (n : ℕ) → Fintype (WickContraction n)

declarations.name: WickContraction.sum_extractEquiv_congr
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_extractEquiv_congr [AddCommMonoid M] {n m : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (f : WickContraction n → M)
    (h : n = m.succ) :
    ∑ c, f c = ∑ (c : WickContraction m), ∑ (k : Option c.uncontracted),
    f (congr h.symm ((extractEquiv (finCongr h i)).symm ⟨c, k⟩))

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_three
declarations.doc:
For `n = 3` there are `4` possible Wick contractions:

- `∅`, corresponding to the case where no fields are contracted.
- `{{0, 1}}`, corresponding to the case where the field at position `0` and `1` are contracted.
- `{{0, 2}}`, corresponding to the case where the field at position `0` and `2` are contracted.
- `{{1, 2}}`, corresponding to the case where the field at position `1` and `2` are contracted.

The proof of this result uses the fact that Lean is an executable programming language
and can calculate all Wick contractions for a given `n`.
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_three (c : WickContraction 3) : c.1 ∈ ({∅, {{0, 1}}, {{0, 2}}, {{1, 2}}} :
    Finset (Finset (Finset (Fin 3))))

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_four
declarations.doc:
For `n = 4` there are `10` possible Wick contractions including e.g.

- `∅`, corresponding to the case where no fields are contracted.
- `{{0, 1}, {2, 3}}`, corresponding to the case where the fields at position `0` and `1` are
  contracted, and the fields at position `2` and `3` are contracted.
- `{{0, 2}, {1, 3}}`, corresponding to the case where the fields at position `0` and `2` are
  contracted, and the fields at position `1` and `3` are contracted.

The proof of this result uses the fact that Lean is an executable programming language
and can calculate all Wick contractions for a given `n`.

modules.title: Inserting an element into a contraction based on a list

sections.text: ## Inserting an element into a list
## insertAndContract and getDual?
## Uncontracted list

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick contraction `φsΛ` for a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`,
an element `φ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, an `i ≤ φs.length` and a `k`
in `Option φsΛ.uncontracted` i.e. is either `none` or
some element of `φsΛ.uncontracted`, the new Wick contraction
`φsΛ.insertAndContract φ i k` is defined by inserting `φ` into `φs` after
the first `i`-elements and moving the values representing the contracted pairs in `φsΛ`
accordingly.
If `k` is not `none`, but rather `some k`, to this contraction is added the contraction
of `φ` (at position `i`) with the new position of `k` after `φ` is added.

In other words, `φsΛ.insertAndContract φ i k` is formed by adding `φ` to `φs` at position `i`,
and contracting `φ` with the field originally at position `k` if `k` is not `none`.
It is a Wick contraction of the list `φs.insertIdx φ i` corresponding to `φs` with `φ` inserted at
position `i`.

The notation `φsΛ ↩Λ φ i k` is used to denote `φsΛ.insertAndContract φ i k`.

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_fstFieldOfContract
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_fstFieldOfContract (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Option φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (a : φsΛ.1) : (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i j).fstFieldOfContract
    (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (insertLift i j a)) =
    finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove (φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract a))

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_sndFieldOfContract
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_sndFieldOfContract (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Option (φsΛ.uncontracted))
    (a : φsΛ.1) : (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i j).sndFieldOfContract
    (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (insertLift i j a)) =
    finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove (φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a))

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_fstFieldOfContract_some_incl
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_fstFieldOfContract_some_incl (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
      (insertAndContract φ φsΛ i (some j)).fstFieldOfContract
      (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm ⟨{i, i.succAbove j}, by
        simp [insertAndContractNat]⟩) =
      if i < i.succAbove j.1 then
      finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i else
      finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j.1)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_none_getDual?_self
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_none_getDual?_self (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i) = none

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_isSome_getDual?_self
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_isSome_getDual?_self (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).getDual?
    (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)).isSome

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_some_getDual?_self_not_none
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_some_getDual?_self_not_none (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    ¬ ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).getDual?
    (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)) = none

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_some_getDual?_self_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_some_getDual?_self_eq (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i))
    = some (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j))

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_some_getDual?_some_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_some_getDual?_some_eq (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).getDual?
      (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j)))
    = some (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_none_succAbove_getDual?_eq_none_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_none_succAbove_getDual?_eq_none_iff (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Fin φs.length) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
      (i.succAbove j)) = none ↔ φsΛ.getDual? j = none

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_some_succAbove_getDual?_eq_option
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_some_succAbove_getDual?_eq_option (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Fin φs.length)
    (k : φsΛ.uncontracted) (hkj : j ≠ k.1) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
    (i.succAbove j)) = Option.map (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm ∘ i.succAbove)
    (φsΛ.getDual? j)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_none_succAbove_getDual?_isSome_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_none_succAbove_getDual?_isSome_iff (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Fin φs.length) :
    ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
      (i.succAbove j))).isSome ↔ (φsΛ.getDual? j).isSome

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_none_getDual?_get_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_none_getDual?_get_eq (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Fin φs.length)
    (h : ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
    (i.succAbove j))).isSome) :
    ((φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).getDual? (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
    (i.succAbove j))).get h = Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
    (i.succAbove ((φsΛ.getDual? j).get (by simpa using h)))

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_sndFieldOfContract_some_incl
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_sndFieldOfContract_some_incl (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).sndFieldOfContract
    (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm ⟨{i, i.succAbove j}, by
      simp [insertAndContractNat]⟩) =
    if i < i.succAbove j.1 then
    finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j.1) else
    finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_none_prod_contractions
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_none_prod_contractions (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ)
    (f : (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).1 → M) [CommMonoid M] :
    ∏ a, f a = ∏ (a : φsΛ.1), f (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
      (insertLift i none a))

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_some_prod_contractions
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContract_some_prod_contractions (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (f : (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).1 → M) [CommMonoid M] :
    ∏ a, f a = f (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
      ⟨{i, i.succAbove j}, by simp [insertAndContractNat]⟩) *
    ∏ (a : φsΛ.1), f (congrLift (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (insertLift i (some j) a))

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractLiftFinset
declarations.doc:
Given a finite set of `Fin φs.length` the finite set of `(φs.insertIdx i φ).length`
formed by mapping elements using `i.succAboveEmb` and `finCongr`.

declarations.name: WickContraction.self_not_mem_insertAndContractLiftFinset
WickContraction.succAbove_mem_insertAndContractLiftFinset
declarations.statement:
lemma succAbove_mem_insertAndContractLiftFinset (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (a : Finset (Fin φs.length)) (j : Fin φs.length) :
    Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j)
    ∈ insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i a ↔ j ∈ a

declarations.name: WickContraction.insert_fin_eq_self
declarations.statement:
lemma insert_fin_eq_self (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : Fin (List.insertIdx φs i φ).length) :
    j = Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i
    ∨ ∃ k, j = Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove k)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertLift_sum
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
`𝓕.FieldOp` and a `i ≤ φs.length` then a sum over
Wick contractions of `φs` with `φ` inserted at `i` is equal to the sum over Wick contractions
`φsΛ` of just `φs` and the sum over optional uncontracted elements of the `φsΛ`.

In other words,

`∑ (φsΛ : WickContraction (φs.insertIdx i φ).length), f φsΛ`

where `(φs.insertIdx i φ)` is `φs` with `φ` inserted at position `i`. is equal to

`∑ (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length), ∑ k, f (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i k) `.

where the sum over `k` is over all `k` in `Option φsΛ.uncontracted`.
declarations.statement:
lemma insertLift_sum (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) [AddCommMonoid M] (f : WickContraction (φs.insertIdx i φ).length → M) :
    ∑ c, f c =
    ∑ (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length), ∑ (k : Option φsΛ.uncontracted), f (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i k)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContract_uncontractedList_none_map
WickContraction.insertAndContract_uncontractedList_none_zero
WickContraction.stat_ofFinset_of_insertAndContractLiftFinset
declarations.statement:
lemma stat_ofFinset_of_insertAndContractLiftFinset (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (a : Finset (Fin φs.length)) :
    (𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨(φs.insertIdx i φ).get, insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i a⟩) = 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, a⟩
