declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick contraction `c` for `n`, a position `i : Fin n.succ` and
an optional uncontracted element `j : Option (c.uncontracted)` of `c`.
The Wick contraction for `n.succ` formed by 'inserting' `i` into `Fin n`
and contracting it optionally with `j`.
declarations.statement:
def insertAndContractNat (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) (j : Option (c.uncontracted)) :
    WickContraction n.succ

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_of_isSome
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_of_isSome (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Option c.uncontracted) (hj : j.isSome) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i j).1 = Insert.insert {i, i.succAbove (j.get hj)}
    (Finset.map (Finset.mapEmbedding i.succAboveEmb).toEmbedding c.1)

declarations.name: WickContraction.self_mem_uncontracted_of_insertAndContractNat_none
declarations.statement:
lemma self_mem_uncontracted_of_insertAndContractNat_none (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    i ∈ (insertAndContractNat c i none).uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.self_not_mem_uncontracted_of_insertAndContractNat_some
declarations.statement:
lemma self_not_mem_uncontracted_of_insertAndContractNat_some (c : WickContraction n)
    (i : Fin n.succ) (j : c.uncontracted) :
    i ∉ (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_succAbove_mem_uncontracted_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_succAbove_mem_uncontracted_iff (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Fin n) :
    (i.succAbove j) ∈ (insertAndContractNat c i none).uncontracted ↔ j ∈ c.uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_uncontracted_insertAndContractNat_none_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_uncontracted_insertAndContractNat_none_iff (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (k : Fin n.succ) : k ∈ (insertAndContractNat c i none).uncontracted ↔
    k = i ∨ ∃ j, k = i.succAbove j ∧ j ∈ c.uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_none_uncontracted
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_none_uncontracted (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i none).uncontracted =
    Insert.insert i (c.uncontracted.map i.succAboveEmb)

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_uncontracted_insertAndContractNat_some_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_uncontracted_insertAndContractNat_some_iff (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (k : Fin n.succ) (j : c.uncontracted) :
    k ∈ (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).uncontracted ↔
    ∃ z, k = i.succAbove z ∧ z ∈ c.uncontracted ∧ z ≠ j

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_some_uncontracted
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_some_uncontracted (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : c.uncontracted) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).uncontracted =
    (c.uncontracted.erase j).map i.succAboveEmb

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_none_getDual?_isNone
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_none_getDual?_isNone (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    ((insertAndContractNat c i none).getDual? i).isNone

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_none_getDual?_eq_none
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_none_getDual?_eq_none (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i none).getDual? i = none

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_succAbove_getDual?_eq_none_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_succAbove_getDual?_eq_none_iff (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Fin n) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i none).getDual? (i.succAbove j) = none ↔ c.getDual? j = none

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_succAbove_getDual?_isSome_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_succAbove_getDual?_isSome_iff (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Fin n) :
    ((insertAndContractNat c i none).getDual? (i.succAbove j)).isSome ↔ (c.getDual? j).isSome

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_succAbove_getDual?_get
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_succAbove_getDual?_get (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Fin n) (h : ((insertAndContractNat c i none).getDual? (i.succAbove j)).isSome) :
    ((insertAndContractNat c i none).getDual? (i.succAbove j)).get h =
    i.succAbove ((c.getDual? j).get (by simpa using h))

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_eq (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : c.uncontracted) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual? i = some (i.succAbove j)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_ne_none
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_ne_none (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : c.uncontracted) (k : Fin n) (hkj : k ≠ j.1) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual? (i.succAbove k) = none ↔ c.getDual? k = none

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_ne_isSome
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_ne_isSome (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : c.uncontracted) (k : Fin n) (hkj : k ≠ j.1) :
    ((insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual? (i.succAbove k)).isSome ↔
    (c.getDual? k).isSome

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_ne_isSome_get
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_ne_isSome_get (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : c.uncontracted) (k : Fin n) (hkj : k ≠ j.1)
    (h : ((insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual? (i.succAbove k)).isSome) :
    ((insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual? (i.succAbove k)).get h =
    i.succAbove ((c.getDual? k).get
      (by simpa [hkj, insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_ne_isSome] using h))

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_of_neq
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_some_getDual?_of_neq (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : c.uncontracted) (k : Fin n) (hkj : k ≠ j.1) :
    (insertAndContractNat c i (some j)).getDual? (i.succAbove k) =
    Option.map i.succAbove (c.getDual? k)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_erase
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_erase (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Option c.uncontracted) : erase (insertAndContractNat c i j) i = c

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_getDualErase
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_getDualErase (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Option c.uncontracted) : (insertAndContractNat c i j).getDualErase i =
    uncontractedCongr (c := c) (c' := (c.insertAndContractNat i j).erase i) (by simp) j

declarations.name: WickContraction.erase_insert
declarations.statement:
lemma erase_insert (c : WickContraction n.succ) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    insertAndContractNat (erase c i) i (getDualErase c i) = c

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertLift
declarations.doc: Lifts a contraction in `c` to a contraction in `(c.insert i j)`.
declarations.statement:
def insertLift {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) (j : Option (c.uncontracted))
    (a : c.1) : (c.insertAndContractNat i j).1

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertLift_injective
declarations.statement:
lemma insertLift_injective {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) (j : Option (c.uncontracted)) :
    Function.Injective (insertLift i j)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertLift_none_surjective
declarations.statement:
lemma insertLift_none_surjective {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) :
    Function.Surjective (c.insertLift i none)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertLift_none_bijective
declarations.statement:
lemma insertLift_none_bijective {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) :
    Function.Bijective (c.insertLift i none)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_fstFieldOfContract
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_fstFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Option (c.uncontracted)) (a : c.1) :
    (c.insertAndContractNat i j).fstFieldOfContract (insertLift i j a) =
      i.succAbove (c.fstFieldOfContract a)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_sndFieldOfContract
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_sndFieldOfContract (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (j : Option (c.uncontracted)) (a : c.1) :
    (c.insertAndContractNat i j).sndFieldOfContract (insertLift i j a) =
    i.succAbove (c.sndFieldOfContract a)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertLiftSome
declarations.doc:
Given a contracted pair for a Wick contraction `WickContraction n`, the
corresponding contracted pair of a wick contraction `(c.insert i (some j))` formed
by inserting an element `i` into the contraction.
declarations.statement:
def insertLiftSome {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) (j : c.uncontracted)
    (a : Unit ⊕ c.1) : (c.insertAndContractNat i (some j)).1

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertLiftSome_injective
declarations.statement:
lemma insertLiftSome_injective {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) (j : c.uncontracted) :
    Function.Injective (insertLiftSome i j)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertLiftSome_surjective
declarations.statement:
lemma insertLiftSome_surjective {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) (j : c.uncontracted) :
    Function.Surjective (insertLiftSome i j)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertLiftSome_bijective
declarations.statement:
lemma insertLiftSome_bijective {c : WickContraction n} (i : Fin n.succ) (j : c.uncontracted) :
    Function.Bijective (insertLiftSome i j)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_injective
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_injective (i : Fin n.succ) :
    Function.Injective (fun c => insertAndContractNat c i none)

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_surjective_on_nodual
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_surjective_on_nodual (i : Fin n.succ)
    (c : WickContraction n.succ) (hc : c.getDual? i = none) :
    ∃ c', insertAndContractNat c' i none = c

declarations.name: WickContraction.insertAndContractNat_bijective
declarations.statement:
lemma insertAndContractNat_bijective (i : Fin n.succ) :
    Function.Bijective (fun c => (⟨insertAndContractNat c i none, by simp⟩ :
      {c : WickContraction n.succ // c.getDual? i = none}))

declarations.name: WickContraction.toInvolution
declarations.doc:
The involution of `Fin n` associated with a Wick contraction `c : WickContraction n` as follows.
If `i : Fin n` is contracted in `c` then it is taken to its dual, otherwise
it is taken to itself.
declarations.statement: def toInvolution : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f}

declarations.name: WickContraction.fromInvolution
declarations.doc:
The Wick contraction formed by an involution `f` of `Fin n` by taking as the contracted
sets of the contraction the orbits of `f` of cardinality `2`.
declarations.statement: def fromInvolution (f : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f}) : WickContraction n

declarations.name: WickContraction.fromInvolution_getDual?_isSome
declarations.statement:
lemma fromInvolution_getDual?_isSome (f : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f})
    (i : Fin n) : ((fromInvolution f).getDual? i).isSome ↔ f.1 i ≠ i

declarations.name: WickContraction.fromInvolution_getDual?_eq_some
declarations.statement:
lemma fromInvolution_getDual?_eq_some (f : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f}) (i : Fin n)
    (h : ((fromInvolution f).getDual? i).isSome) :
    ((fromInvolution f).getDual? i) = some (f.1 i)

declarations.name: WickContraction.fromInvolution_getDual?_get
declarations.statement:
lemma fromInvolution_getDual?_get (f : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f}) (i : Fin n)
    (h : ((fromInvolution f).getDual? i).isSome) :
    ((fromInvolution f).getDual? i).get h = (f.1 i)

declarations.name: WickContraction.toInvolution_fromInvolution
declarations.statement: lemma toInvolution_fromInvolution : fromInvolution c.toInvolution = c

declarations.name: WickContraction.fromInvolution_toInvolution
declarations.statement:
lemma fromInvolution_toInvolution (f : {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f}) :
    (fromInvolution f).toInvolution = f

declarations.name: WickContraction.equivInvolution
declarations.doc:
The equivalence between Wick contractions for `n` and involutions of `Fin n`.
The involution of `Fin n` associated with a Wick contraction `c : WickContraction n` as follows.
If `i : Fin n` is contracted in `c` then it is taken to its dual, otherwise
it is taken to itself.
declarations.statement: def equivInvolution : WickContraction n ≃ {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f}

modules.title: Full contraction
modules.doc: We say that a contraction is full if it has no uncontracted fields.

declarations.name: WickContraction.IsFull
declarations.doc:
A contraction is full if there are no uncontracted fields, i.e. the finite set
of uncontracted fields is empty.
declarations.statement: def IsFull : Prop

declarations.doc: The condition on whether or not a contraction is full is decidable.
declarations.statement: instance : Decidable (IsFull c)

declarations.name: WickContraction.isFull_iff_equivInvolution_no_fixed_point
declarations.statement:
lemma isFull_iff_equivInvolution_no_fixed_point :
    IsFull c ↔ ∀ (i : Fin n), (equivInvolution c).1 i ≠ i

declarations.name: WickContraction.isFullInvolutionEquiv
declarations.doc: The equivalence between full contractions and fixed-point free involutions.
declarations.statement:
def isFullInvolutionEquiv : {c : WickContraction n // IsFull c} ≃
    {f : Fin n → Fin n // Function.Involutive f ∧ (∀ i, f i ≠ i)}

declarations.name: WickContraction.card_of_isfull_even
declarations.doc: If `n` is even then the number of full contractions is `(n-1)!!`.
declarations.statement:
theorem card_of_isfull_even (he : Even n) :
    Fintype.card {c : WickContraction n // IsFull c} = (n - 1)‼

declarations.name: WickContraction.card_of_isfull_odd
declarations.doc:
If `n` is odd then there are no full contractions. This is because
there will always be at least one element unpaired.
declarations.statement:
theorem card_of_isfull_odd (ho : Odd n) :
    Fintype.card {c : WickContraction n // IsFull c} = 0

declarations.name: WickContraction.join
declarations.doc:
Given a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs` and a Wick contraction
`φsucΛ` of `[φsΛ]ᵘᶜ`, `join φsΛ φsucΛ` is defined as the Wick contraction of `φs` consisting of
the contractions in `φsΛ` and those in `φsucΛ`.

As an example, for `φs = [φ1, φ2, φ3, φ4]`,
`φsΛ = {{0, 1}}` corresponding to the contraction of `φ1` and `φ2` in `φs` and
`φsucΛ = {{0, 1}}`
corresponding to the contraction of `φ3` and `φ4` in `[φsΛ]ᵘᶜ = [φ3, φ4]`, then
`join φsΛ φsucΛ` is the contraction `{{0, 1}, {2, 3}}` of `φs`.
declarations.statement:
def join {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) : WickContraction φs.length

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_congr
WickContraction.joinLiftLeft
declarations.doc:
Given a contracting pair within `φsΛ` the corresponding contracting pair within
`(join φsΛ φsucΛ)`.

    {φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length} : φsΛ.1 → (join φsΛ φsucΛ).1

Given a contracting pair within `φsucΛ` the corresponding contracting pair within
`(join φsΛ φsucΛ)`.
declarations.statement:
def joinLiftRight {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length}

declarations.name: WickContraction.joinLiftRight_injective
WickContraction.jointLiftLeft_disjoint_joinLiftRight
WickContraction.jointLiftLeft_ne_joinLiftRight
WickContraction.joinLift
declarations.doc:
The map from contracted pairs of `φsΛ` and `φsucΛ` to contracted pairs in
`(join φsΛ φsucΛ)`.
declarations.statement:
def joinLift {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length}
    {φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length} : φsΛ.1 ⊕ φsucΛ.1 → (join φsΛ φsucΛ).1

declarations.name: WickContraction.joinLift_injective
declarations.statement:

lemma joinLift_bijective {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length}

declarations.name: WickContraction.prod_join
declarations.statement:
lemma prod_join {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)

      ∏ (a : (join φsΛ φsucΛ).1), f a = (∏ (a : φsΛ.1), f (joinLiftLeft a)) *
      ∏ (a : φsucΛ.1), f (joinLiftRight a)

lemma exists_mem_left_uncontracted_of_mem_join_uncontracted {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}

lemma exists_mem_right_uncontracted_of_mem_join_uncontracted {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}

declarations.statement:
lemma join_uncontractedList {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (join φsΛ φsucΛ).uncontractedList = List.map uncontractedListEmd φsucΛ.uncontractedList

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_uncontractedList_get
declarations.statement:
lemma join_uncontractedList_get {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    ((join φsΛ φsucΛ).uncontractedList).get =
    φsΛ.uncontractedListEmd ∘ (φsucΛ.uncontractedList).get ∘
        (Fin.cast (by rw [join_uncontractedList]; simp))

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_uncontractedListGet
declarations.statement:
lemma join_uncontractedListGet {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (join φsΛ φsucΛ).uncontractedListGet = φsucΛ.uncontractedListGet

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_uncontractedListEmb
declarations.statement:
lemma join_uncontractedListEmb {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (join φsΛ φsucΛ).uncontractedListEmd =
    ((finCongr (congrArg List.length (join_uncontractedListGet _ _))).toEmbedding.trans
      φsucΛ.uncontractedListEmd).trans φsΛ.uncontractedListEmd

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_assoc
declarations.statement:
lemma join_assoc {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) (φsucΛ' : WickContraction [φsΛ.join φsucΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    join (join φsΛ φsucΛ) (φsucΛ') = join φsΛ (join φsucΛ (congr
      (congrArg List.length (join_uncontractedListGet _ _)) φsucΛ'))

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_getDual?_apply_uncontractedListEmb_eq_none_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma join_getDual?_apply_uncontractedListEmb_eq_none_iff {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}

    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) (i : Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (join φsΛ φsucΛ).getDual? (uncontractedListEmd i) = none
    ↔ φsucΛ.getDual? i = none

lemma join_getDual?_apply_uncontractedListEmb_isSome_iff {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}

    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) (i : Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    ((join φsΛ φsucΛ).getDual? (uncontractedListEmd i)).isSome
    ↔ (φsucΛ.getDual? i).isSome

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_getDual?_apply_uncontractedListEmb_some
declarations.statement:
lemma join_getDual?_apply_uncontractedListEmb_some {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) (i : Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length)

lemma join_getDual?_apply_uncontractedListEmb {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}

lemma join_sub_quot (S : Finset (Finset (Fin φs.length))) (ha : S ⊆ φsΛ.1) :

declarations.name: WickContraction.subContraction_card_plus_quotContraction_card_eq

lemma subContraction_card_plus_quotContraction_card_eq (S : Finset (Finset (Fin φs.length)))
    (ha : S ⊆ φsΛ.1) :
    (subContraction S ha).1.card + (quotContraction S ha).1.card = φsΛ.1.card

lemma join_singleton_getDual?_left {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}

    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [singleton h]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (join (singleton h) φsucΛ).getDual? i = some j

declarations.statement:
lemma join_singleton_getDual?_right {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    {i j : Fin φs.length} (h : i < j)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [singleton h]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (join (singleton h) φsucΛ).getDual? j = some i

declarations.name: WickContraction.exists_contraction_pair_of_card_ge_zero
WickContraction.exists_join_singleton_of_card_ge_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_join_singleton_of_card_ge_zero {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (h : 0 < φsΛ.1.card) (hc : φsΛ.GradingCompliant) :
    ∃ (i j : Fin φs.length) (h : i < j) (φsucΛ : WickContraction [singleton h]ᵘᶜ.length),
    φsΛ = join (singleton h) φsucΛ ∧ (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[i]) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j])
    ∧ φsucΛ.GradingCompliant ∧ φsucΛ.1.card + 1 = φsΛ.1.card

modules.title: Permutations of Wick contractions
modules.doc:
We define two Wick contractions to be permutations of each other
if the Wick term they produce is equal.

## TODO

The long term aim is to simplify this condition as much as possible,
so that it can eventually be made decidable.

It should become apparent that two Wick contractions are permutations of each other
if they correspond to the same Feynman diagram.
Please speak to JTS before working in this direction.

declarations.name: WickContraction.Perm
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, and two Wick contractions `φsΛ₁` and `φsΛ₂` of `φs`,
we say that `φsΛ₁` and `φsΛ₂` are permutations of each other if they have the same Wick term.
declarations.statement: def Perm {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ₁ φsΛ₂ : WickContraction φs.length) : Prop

declarations.name: WickContraction.Perm.refl
declarations.doc: The reflexivity of the `Perm` relation.
declarations.statement: lemma refl : Perm φsΛ φsΛ

declarations.name: WickContraction.Perm.symm
declarations.doc: The symmetry of the `Perm` relation.
declarations.statement: lemma symm (h : Perm φsΛ₁ φsΛ₂) : Perm φsΛ₂ φsΛ₁

declarations.name: WickContraction.Perm.trans
declarations.doc: The transitivity of the `Perm` relation.
declarations.statement:
lemma trans (h12 : Perm φsΛ₁ φsΛ₂) (h23 : Perm φsΛ₂ φsΛ₃) :
    Perm φsΛ₁ φsΛ₃

declarations.name: WickContraction.signFinset
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick contraction `c : WickContraction n` and `i1 i2 : Fin n` the finite set
of elements of `Fin n` between `i1` and `i2` which are either uncontracted
or are contracted but are contracted with an element occurring after `i1`.
In other words, the elements of `Fin n` between `i1` and `i2` which are not
contracted with before `i1`.
One should assume `i1 < i2` otherwise this finite set is empty.
declarations.statement: def signFinset (c : WickContraction n) (i1 i2 : Fin n) : Finset (Fin n)

declarations.name: WickContraction.sign
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, and a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`,
  the complex number `φsΛ.sign` is defined to be the sign (`1` or `-1`) corresponding
  to the number of `fermionic`-`fermionic` exchanges that must be done to put
  contracted pairs within `φsΛ` next to one another, starting recursively
  from the contracted pair
  whose first element occurs at the left-most position.

  As an example, if `[φ1, φ2, φ3, φ4]` correspond to fermionic fields then the sign
  associated with
- `{{0, 1}}` is `1`
- `{{0, 1}, {2, 3}}` is `1`
- `{{0, 2}, {1, 3}}` is `-1`
declarations.statement: def sign (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) : ℂ

declarations.name: WickContraction.sign_empty
declarations.statement:
lemma sign_empty (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    sign φs empty = 1

declarations.name: WickContraction.sign_congr
declarations.statement:
lemma sign_congr {φs φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : φs = φs') (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    sign φs' (congr (by simp [h]) φsΛ) = sign φs φsΛ

modules.title: Sign on inserting and not contracting

declarations.name: WickContraction.signFinset_insertAndContract_none
declarations.statement:
lemma signFinset_insertAndContract_none (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (i1 i2 : Fin φs.length) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).signFinset (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
    (i.succAbove i1)) (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove i2)) =
    if i.succAbove i1 < i ∧ i < i.succAbove i2 then
      Insert.insert (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)
      (insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i (φsΛ.signFinset i1 i2))
    else
      (insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i (φsΛ.signFinset i1 i2))

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertNone
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick contraction `φsΛ` associated with a list of states `φs`
and an `i : Fin φs.length.succ`, the change in sign of the contraction associated with
inserting `φ` into `φs` at position `i` without contracting it.

For each contracted pair `{a1, a2}` in `φsΛ` if `a1 < a2` such that `i` is within the range
`a1 < i < a2` we pick up a sign equal to `𝓢(φ, φs[a2])`.
declarations.statement:
def signInsertNone (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) : ℂ

declarations.name: WickContraction.sign_insert_none_eq_signInsertNone_mul_sign
declarations.statement:
lemma sign_insert_none_eq_signInsertNone_mul_sign (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).sign = (φsΛ.signInsertNone φ φs i) * φsΛ.sign

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertNone_eq_mul_fst_snd
declarations.statement:
lemma signInsertNone_eq_mul_fst_snd (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) :
  φsΛ.signInsertNone φ φs i = ∏ (a : φsΛ.1),
    (if i.succAbove (φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract a) < i then
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a])
    else 1) *
    (if i.succAbove (φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a) < i then
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a])
    else 1)

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertNone_eq_prod_prod
declarations.statement:
lemma signInsertNone_eq_prod_prod (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (hG : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ) :
    φsΛ.signInsertNone φ φs i = ∏ (a : φsΛ.1), ∏ (x : a),
      (if i.succAbove x < i then 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[x.1]) else 1)

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertNone_eq_prod_getDual?_Some
declarations.statement:
lemma signInsertNone_eq_prod_getDual?_Some (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (hG : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ) :
    φsΛ.signInsertNone φ φs i = ∏ (x : Fin φs.length),
      if (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome then
        (if i.succAbove x < i then 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[x.1]) else 1)
      else 1

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertNone_eq_filter_map
declarations.statement:
lemma signInsertNone_eq_filter_map (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (hG : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ) :
    φsΛ.signInsertNone φ φs i =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ((List.filter (fun x => (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome ∧ i.succAbove x < i)
    (List.finRange φs.length)).map φs.get))

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertNone_eq_filterset
declarations.doc:
The following signs for a grading compliant Wick contraction are equal:
- The sign `φsΛ.signInsertNone φ φs i` which is given by the following: For each
  contracted pair `{a1, a2}` in `φsΛ` if `a1 < a2`
  such that `i` is within the range `a1 < i < a2` we pick up a sign equal to `𝓢(φ, φs[a2])`.
- The sign got by moving `φ` through `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁` and only picking up a sign when `φᵢ` has a dual.
These are equal since: Both ignore uncontracted fields, and for a contracted pair `{a1, a2}`
with `a1 < a2`
- if `i < a1 < a2` then we don't pick up a sign from either `φₐ₁` or `φₐ₂`.
- if `a1 < i < a2` then we pick up a sign from `φₐ₁` cases which is equal to `𝓢(φ, φs[a2])`
(since `φsΛ` is grading compliant).
- if `a1 < a2 < i` then we pick up a sign from both `φₐ₁` and `φₐ₂` which cancel each other out.
declarations.statement:
lemma signInsertNone_eq_filterset (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (hG : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ) :
    φsΛ.signInsertNone φ φs i = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, Finset.univ.filter
    (fun x => (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome ∧ i.succAbove x < i)⟩)

declarations.name: WickContraction.sign_insert_none
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a graded compliant Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`,
an `i ≤ φs.length`, and a `φ` in `𝓕.FieldOp`, then
`(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).sign = s * φsΛ.sign`
where `s` is the sign arrived at by moving `φ` through the elements of `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁` which
are contracted with some element.

The proof of this result involves a careful consideration of the contributions of different
`FieldOp`s in `φs` to the sign of `φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none`.
declarations.statement:
lemma sign_insert_none (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (hG : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).sign = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, Finset.univ.filter
    (fun x => (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome ∧ i.succAbove x < i)⟩) * φsΛ.sign

declarations.name: WickContraction.sign_insert_none_zero
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a graded compliant Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`,
and a `φ` in `𝓕.FieldOp`, then `(φsΛ ↩Λ φ 0 none).sign = φsΛ.sign`.

This is a direct corollary of `sign_insert_none`.
declarations.statement:
lemma sign_insert_none_zero (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) : (φsΛ ↩Λ φ 0 none).sign = φsΛ.sign

modules.title: Sign on inserting and contracting
modules.doc:
The main results of this file are `sign_insert_some_of_lt` and `sign_insert_some_of_not_lt` which
write the sign of `(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).sign` in terms of the sign of `φsΛ`.

declarations.name: WickContraction.stat_ofFinset_eq_one_of_gradingCompliant
declarations.statement:
lemma stat_ofFinset_eq_one_of_gradingCompliant (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (a : Finset (Fin φs.length)) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (hg : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ)
    (hnon : ∀ i, φsΛ.getDual? i = none → i ∉ a)
    (hsom : ∀ i, (h : (φsΛ.getDual? i).isSome) → i ∈ a → (φsΛ.getDual? i).get h ∈ a) :
    (𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, a⟩) = 1

declarations.name: WickContraction.signFinset_insertAndContract_some
declarations.statement:
lemma signFinset_insertAndContract_some (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (i1 i2 : Fin φs.length)
    (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).signFinset (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm
    (i.succAbove i1)) (Fin.cast (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove i2)) =
    if i.succAbove i1 < i ∧ i < i.succAbove i2 ∧ (i1 < j) then
      Insert.insert (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)
      (insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i (φsΛ.signFinset i1 i2))
    else
      if i1 < j ∧ j < i2 ∧ ¬ i.succAbove i1 < i then
        (insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i (φsΛ.signFinset i1 i2)).erase
        (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j))
      else
        (insertAndContractLiftFinset φ i (φsΛ.signFinset i1 i2))

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertSomeProd
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick contraction `φsΛ` the sign defined in the following way,
related to inserting a field `φ` at position `i` and contracting it with `j : φsΛ.uncontracted`.
- For each contracted pair `{a1, a2}` in `φsΛ` with `a1 < a2` the sign
  `𝓢(φ, φₐ₂)` if `a₁ < i ≤ a₂` and `a₁ < j`.
- For each contracted pair `{a1, a2}` in `φsΛ` with `a1 < a2` the sign
  `𝓢(φⱼ, φₐ₂)` if `a₁ < j < a₂` and `i < a₁`.
declarations.statement:
def signInsertSomeProd (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) : ℂ

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertSomeCoef
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick contraction `φsΛ` the sign defined in the following way,
related to inserting a field `φ` at position `i` and contracting it with `j : φsΛ.uncontracted`.
- If `j < i`, for each field `φₐ` in `φⱼ₊₁…φᵢ₋₁` without a dual at position `< j`
  the sign `𝓢(φₐ, φᵢ)`.
- Else, for each field `φₐ` in `φᵢ…φⱼ₋₁` of `φs` without dual at position `< i` the sign
  `𝓢(φₐ, φⱼ)`.
declarations.statement:
def signInsertSomeCoef (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) : ℂ

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertSome
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick contraction `φsΛ` associated with a list of states `φs`
and an `i : Fin φs.length.succ`, the change in sign of the contraction associated with
inserting `φ` into `φs` at position `i` and contracting it with `j : c.uncontracted`.
declarations.statement:
def signInsertSome (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) : ℂ

declarations.name: WickContraction.sign_insert_some
declarations.statement:
lemma sign_insert_some (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).sign = (φsΛ.signInsertSome φ φs i j) * φsΛ.sign

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertSomeProd_eq_one_if
declarations.statement:
lemma signInsertSomeProd_eq_one_if (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (hφj : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j.1])) :
  φsΛ.signInsertSomeProd φ φs i j =
  ∏ (a : φsΛ.1),
    if (φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract a) < j
      ∧ (i.succAbove (φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract a) < i ∧ i < i.succAbove (φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a)
      ∨ j < (φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a) ∧ ¬ i.succAbove (φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract a) < i)
    then
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a])
    else
      1

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertSomeProd_eq_prod_prod
declarations.statement:
lemma signInsertSomeProd_eq_prod_prod (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) (hφj : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j.1]))
    (hg : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ) :
  φsΛ.signInsertSomeProd φ φs i j =
  ∏ (a : φsΛ.1), ∏ (x : a.1), if x.1 < j
      ∧ (i.succAbove x.1 < i ∧
      i < i.succAbove ((φsΛ.getDual? x.1).get (getDual?_isSome_of_mem φsΛ a x))
      ∨ j < ((φsΛ.getDual? x.1).get (getDual?_isSome_of_mem φsΛ a x)) ∧ ¬ i.succAbove x < i)
    then
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[x.1])
    else
      1

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertSomeProd_eq_prod_fin
declarations.statement:
lemma signInsertSomeProd_eq_prod_fin (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) (hφj : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j.1]))
    (hg : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ) :
  φsΛ.signInsertSomeProd φ φs i j =
    ∏ (x : Fin φs.length),
      if h : (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome then
          if x < j ∧ (i.succAbove x < i ∧ i < i.succAbove ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h)
            ∨ j < ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h) ∧ ¬ i.succAbove x < i)
          then 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[x.1])
          else 1
      else 1

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertSomeProd_eq_finset
declarations.statement:
lemma signInsertSomeProd_eq_finset (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) (hφj : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j.1]))
    (hg : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ) :
    φsΛ.signInsertSomeProd φ φs i j =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome ∧
      ∀ (h : (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome),
      x < j ∧ (i.succAbove x < i ∧ i < i.succAbove ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h)
      ∨ j < ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h) ∧ ¬ i.succAbove x < i)))⟩)

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertSomeCoef_if
declarations.statement:
lemma signInsertSomeCoef_if (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) (hφj : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j.1])) :
    φsΛ.signInsertSomeCoef φ φs i j =
    if i < i.succAbove j then
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨(φs.insertIdx i φ).get,
      (signFinset (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)) (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)
      (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j)))⟩)
    else
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨(φs.insertIdx i φ).get,
      signFinset (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j))
      (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j))
      (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)⟩)

declarations.name: WickContraction.stat_signFinset_insert_some_self_fst
declarations.statement:
lemma stat_signFinset_insert_some_self_fst
    (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
  (𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨(φs.insertIdx i φ).get,
    (signFinset (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)) (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i)
      (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j)))⟩) =
  𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get,
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => i < i.succAbove x ∧ x < j ∧ ((φsΛ.getDual? x = none) ∨
      ∀ (h : (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome), i < i.succAbove ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h))))⟩

declarations.name: WickContraction.stat_signFinset_insert_some_self_snd
declarations.statement:
lemma stat_signFinset_insert_some_self_snd (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    (𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨(φs.insertIdx i φ).get,
    (signFinset (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j))
      (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm (i.succAbove j))
      (finCongr (insertIdx_length_fin φ φs i).symm i))⟩) =
    𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get,
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => j < x ∧ i.succAbove x < i ∧ ((φsΛ.getDual? x = none) ∨
      ∀ (h : (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome), j < ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h))))⟩

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertSomeCoef_eq_finset
declarations.statement:
lemma signInsertSomeCoef_eq_finset (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (hφj : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j.1])) : φsΛ.signInsertSomeCoef φ φs i j =
    if i < i.succAbove j then
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get,
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => i < i.succAbove x ∧ x < j ∧ ((φsΛ.getDual? x = none) ∨
        ∀ (h : (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome), i < i.succAbove ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h))))⟩)
    else
      𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get,
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => j < x ∧ i.succAbove x < i ∧ ((φsΛ.getDual? x = none) ∨
        ∀ (h : (φsΛ.getDual? x).isSome), j < ((φsΛ.getDual? x).get h))))⟩)

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertSome_mul_filter_contracted_of_lt
declarations.doc:
The following two signs are equal for `i.succAbove k < i`. The sign `signInsertSome φ φs φsΛ i k`
which is constructed as follows:
1a. For each contracted pair `{a1, a2}` in `φsΛ` with `a1 < a2` the sign
  `𝓢(φ, φₐ₂)` if `a₁ < i ≤ a₂` and `a₁ < k`.
1b. For each contracted pair `{a1, a2}` in `φsΛ` with `a1 < a2` the sign
  `𝓢(φⱼ, φₐ₂)` if `a₁ < k < a₂` and `i < a₁`.
1c. For each field `φₐ` in `φₖ₊₁…φᵢ₋₁` without a dual at position `< k`
  the sign `𝓢(φₐ, φᵢ)`.
and the sign constructed as follows:
2a. For each uncontracted field `φₐ` in `φ₀…φₖ` in `φsΛ` the sign `𝓢(φ, φₐ)`
2b. For each field in `φₐ` in `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁` the sign `𝓢(φ, φₐ)`.

The outline of why this is true can be got by considering contributions of fields.
- `φₐ`, `i ≤ a`. No contributions.
- `φₖ`, `k -> 2a`, `k -> 2b`
- `φₐ`, `a ≤ k` uncontracted `a -> 2a`, `a -> 2b`.
- `φₐ`, `k < a < i` uncontracted `a -> 1c`, `a -> 2b`.

For contracted fields `{a₁, a₂}` in `φsΛ` with `a₁ < a₂` we have the following cases:
- `φₐ₁` `φₐ₂` `a₁ < a₂ < k < i`, `a₁ -> 2b`, `a₂ -> 2b`,
- `φₐ₁` `φₐ₂` `a₁ < k < a₂ < i`, `a₁ -> 2b`, `a₂ -> 2b`,
- `φₐ₁` `φₐ₂` `a₁ < k < i ≤ a₂`, `a₁ -> 2b`, `a₂ -> 1a`
- `φₐ₁` `φₐ₂` `k < a₁ < a₂ < i`, `a₁ -> 2b`, `a₂ -> 2b`, `a₁ -> 1c`, `a₂ -> 1c`
- `φₐ₁` `φₐ₂` `k < a₁ < i ≤ a₂ `,`a₁ -> 2b`, `a₁ -> 1c`
- `φₐ₁` `φₐ₂` `k < i ≤ a₁ < a₂ `, No contributions.
declarations.statement:
lemma signInsertSome_mul_filter_contracted_of_lt (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (hk : i.succAbove k < i) (hg : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ ∧ (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[k.1]) :
    signInsertSome φ φs φsΛ i k *
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, φsΛ.uncontracted.filter (fun x => x ≤ ↑k)⟩)
    = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, Finset.univ.filter (fun x => i.succAbove x < i)⟩)

declarations.name: WickContraction.signInsertSome_mul_filter_contracted_of_not_lt
declarations.doc:
The following two signs are equal for `i < i.succAbove k`.
The sign `signInsertSome φ φs φsΛ i k` which is constructed
as follows:
1a. For each contracted pair `{a1, a2}` in `φsΛ` with `a1 < a2` the sign
  `𝓢(φ, φₐ₂)` if `a₁ < i ≤ a₂` and `a₁ < k`.
1b. For each contracted pair `{a1, a2}` in `φsΛ` with `a1 < a2` the sign
  `𝓢(φⱼ, φₐ₂)` if `a₁ < k < a₂` and `i < a₁`.
1c. For each field `φₐ` in `φᵢ…φₖ₋₁` of `φs` without dual at position `< i` the sign
  `𝓢(φₐ, φⱼ)`.
and the sign constructed as follows:
2a. For each uncontracted field `φₐ` in `φ₀…φₖ₋₁` in `φsΛ` the sign `𝓢(φ, φₐ)`
2b. For each field in `φₐ` in `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁` the sign `𝓢(φ, φₐ)`.

The outline of why this is true can be got by considering contributions of fields.
- `φₐ`, `k < a`. No contributions.
- `φₖ`, No Contributes
- `φₐ`, `a < i` uncontracted `a -> 2a`, `a -> 2b`.
- `φₐ`, `i ≤ a < k` uncontracted `a -> 1c`, `a -> 2a`.

For contracted fields `{a₁, a₂}` in `φsΛ` with `a₁ < a₂` we have the following cases:
- `φₐ₁` `φₐ₂` `a₁ < a₂ < i ≤ k`, `a₁ -> 2b`, `a₂ -> 2b`
- `φₐ₁` `φₐ₂` `a₁ < i ≤ a₂ < k`, `a₁ -> 2b`, `a₂ -> 1a`
- `φₐ₁` `φₐ₂` `a₁ < i ≤ k < a₂`, `a₁ -> 2b`, `a₂ -> 1a`
- `φₐ₁` `φₐ₂` `i ≤ a₁ < a₂ < k`, `a₂ -> 1c`, `a₁ -> 1c`
- `φₐ₁` `φₐ₂` `i ≤ a₁ < k < a₂ `, `a₁ -> 1c`, `a₁ -> 1b`
- `φₐ₁` `φₐ₂` `i ≤ k ≤ a₁ < a₂ `, No contributions
declarations.statement:
lemma signInsertSome_mul_filter_contracted_of_not_lt (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (hk : ¬ i.succAbove k < i) (hg : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ ∧ (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[k.1]) :
    signInsertSome φ φs φsΛ i k *
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, φsΛ.uncontracted.filter (fun x => x < ↑k)⟩)
    = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, Finset.univ.filter (fun x => i.succAbove x < i)⟩)

declarations.name: WickContraction.sign_insert_some_of_lt
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
  `𝓕.FieldOp`, a `i ≤ φs.length` and a `k` in `φsΛ.uncontracted` such that `k<i`,
the sign of `φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)` is equal to the product of
- the sign associated with moving `φ` through the `φsΛ`-uncontracted `FieldOp` in `φ₀…φₖ`,
- the sign associated with moving `φ` through all `FieldOp` in `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁`,
- the sign of `φsΛ`.

The proof of this result involves a careful consideration of the contributions of different
`FieldOp` in `φs` to the sign of `φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma sign_insert_some_of_lt (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (hk : i.succAbove k < i) (hg : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ ∧ (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[k.1]) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).sign =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, φsΛ.uncontracted.filter (fun x => x ≤ ↑k)⟩)
    * 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, Finset.univ.filter (fun x => i.succAbove x < i)⟩)
    * φsΛ.sign

declarations.name: WickContraction.sign_insert_some_of_not_lt
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
  `𝓕.FieldOp`, a `i ≤ φs.length` and a `k` in `φsΛ.uncontracted` such that `i ≤ k`,
the sign of `φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)` is equal to the product of
- the sign associated with moving `φ` through the `φsΛ`-uncontracted `FieldOp` in `φ₀…φₖ₋₁`,
- the sign associated with moving `φ` through all the `FieldOp` in `φ₀…φᵢ₋₁`,
- the sign of `φsΛ`.

The proof of this result involves a careful consideration of the contributions of different
`FieldOp` in `φs` to the sign of `φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma sign_insert_some_of_not_lt (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (hk : ¬ i.succAbove k < i) (hg : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ ∧ (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = 𝓕 |>ₛ φs[k.1]) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).sign =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, φsΛ.uncontracted.filter (fun x => x < ↑k)⟩)
    * 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, Finset.univ.filter (fun x => i.succAbove x < i)⟩) *
    φsΛ.sign

declarations.name: WickContraction.sign_insert_some_zero
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
  `𝓕.FieldOp`, and a `k` in `φsΛ.uncontracted`,
the sign of `φsΛ ↩Λ φ 0 (some k)` is equal to the product of
- the sign associated with moving `φ` through the `φsΛ`-uncontracted `FieldOp` in `φ₀…φₖ₋₁`,
- the sign of `φsΛ`.

This is a direct corollary of `sign_insert_some_of_not_lt`.
declarations.statement:
lemma sign_insert_some_zero (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (hn : GradingCompliant φs φsΛ ∧ (𝓕|>ₛφ) = 𝓕|>ₛφs[k.1]) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ 0 k).sign = 𝓢(𝓕|>ₛφ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (φsΛ.uncontracted.filter (fun x => x < ↑k))⟩) *
    φsΛ.sign

modules.title: Sign associated with joining two Wick contractions

declarations.name: WickContraction.stat_signFinset_right
declarations.statement:
lemma stat_signFinset_right {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) (i j : Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨[φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.get, φsucΛ.signFinset i j⟩) =
    (𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (φsucΛ.signFinset i j).map uncontractedListEmd⟩)

declarations.name: WickContraction.signFinset_right_map_uncontractedListEmd_eq_filter
declarations.statement:
lemma signFinset_right_map_uncontractedListEmd_eq_filter {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length)
    (i j : Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) : (φsucΛ.signFinset i j).map uncontractedListEmd =
    ((join φsΛ φsucΛ).signFinset (uncontractedListEmd i) (uncontractedListEmd j)).filter
    (fun c => c ∈ φsΛ.uncontracted)

declarations.name: WickContraction.sign_right_eq_prod_mul_prod
declarations.statement:
lemma sign_right_eq_prod_mul_prod {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    φsucΛ.sign = (∏ a, 𝓢(𝓕|>ₛ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ[φsucΛ.sndFieldOfContract a], 𝓕|>ₛ ⟨φs.get,
    ((join φsΛ φsucΛ).signFinset (uncontractedListEmd (φsucΛ.fstFieldOfContract a))
      (uncontractedListEmd (φsucΛ.sndFieldOfContract a))).filter
      (fun c => ¬ c ∈ φsΛ.uncontracted)⟩)) *
    (∏ a, 𝓢(𝓕|>ₛ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ[φsucΛ.sndFieldOfContract a], 𝓕|>ₛ ⟨φs.get,
      ((join φsΛ φsucΛ).signFinset (uncontractedListEmd (φsucΛ.fstFieldOfContract a))
        (uncontractedListEmd (φsucΛ.sndFieldOfContract a)))⟩))

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_singleton_signFinset_eq_filter
declarations.statement:
lemma join_singleton_signFinset_eq_filter {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    {i j : Fin φs.length} (h : i < j)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [singleton h]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (join (singleton h) φsucΛ).signFinset i j =
    ((singleton h).signFinset i j).filter (fun c => ¬
    (((join (singleton h) φsucΛ).getDual? c).isSome ∧
    ((h1 : ((join (singleton h) φsucΛ).getDual? c).isSome) →
    (((join (singleton h) φsucΛ).getDual? c).get h1) < i)))

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_singleton_left_signFinset_eq_filter
declarations.statement:
lemma join_singleton_left_signFinset_eq_filter {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    {i j : Fin φs.length} (h : i < j)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [singleton h]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (singleton h).signFinset i j⟩)
    = (𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (join (singleton h) φsucΛ).signFinset i j⟩) *
      (𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, ((singleton h).signFinset i j).filter (fun c =>
      (((join (singleton h) φsucΛ).getDual? c).isSome ∧
      ((h1 : ((join (singleton h) φsucΛ).getDual? c).isSome) →
      (((join (singleton h) φsucΛ).getDual? c).get h1) < i)))⟩)

declarations.name: WickContraction.joinSignRightExtra
declarations.doc:
The difference in sign between `φsucΛ.sign` and the direct contribution of `φsucΛ` to
`(join (singleton h) φsucΛ)`.

declarations.name: WickContraction.joinSignLeftExtra
declarations.doc:
The difference in sign between `(singleton h).sign` and the direct contribution of
`(singleton h)` to `(join (singleton h) φsucΛ)`.

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_singleton_sign_left
declarations.statement:
lemma join_singleton_sign_left {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    {i j : Fin φs.length} (h : i < j)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [singleton h]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (singleton h).sign = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j],
    (𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (join (singleton h) φsucΛ).signFinset i j⟩)) * (joinSignLeftExtra h φsucΛ)

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_singleton_sign_right
declarations.statement:
lemma join_singleton_sign_right {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    {i j : Fin φs.length} (h : i < j)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [singleton h]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    φsucΛ.sign =
    (joinSignRightExtra h φsucΛ) *
    (∏ a, 𝓢(𝓕|>ₛ [singleton h]ᵘᶜ[φsucΛ.sndFieldOfContract a], 𝓕|>ₛ ⟨φs.get,
      ((join (singleton h) φsucΛ).signFinset (uncontractedListEmd (φsucΛ.fstFieldOfContract a))
        (uncontractedListEmd (φsucΛ.sndFieldOfContract a)))⟩))

declarations.name: WickContraction.joinSignRightExtra_eq_i_j_finset_eq_if
declarations.statement:
lemma joinSignRightExtra_eq_i_j_finset_eq_if {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    {i j : Fin φs.length} (h : i < j) (φsucΛ : WickContraction [singleton h]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    joinSignRightExtra h φsucΛ = ∏ a,
    𝓢((𝓕|>ₛ [singleton h]ᵘᶜ[φsucΛ.sndFieldOfContract a]),
    𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (if uncontractedListEmd (φsucΛ.fstFieldOfContract a) < j ∧
        j < uncontractedListEmd (φsucΛ.sndFieldOfContract a) ∧
        uncontractedListEmd (φsucΛ.fstFieldOfContract a) < i then {j} else ∅)
        ∪ (if uncontractedListEmd (φsucΛ.fstFieldOfContract a) < i ∧
        i < uncontractedListEmd (φsucΛ.sndFieldOfContract a) then {i} else ∅)⟩)

declarations.name: WickContraction.joinSignLeftExtra_eq_joinSignRightExtra
declarations.statement:
lemma joinSignLeftExtra_eq_joinSignRightExtra {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    {i j : Fin φs.length} (h : i < j) (hs : (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[i]) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j]))
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [singleton h]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    joinSignLeftExtra h φsucΛ = joinSignRightExtra h φsucΛ

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_sign_singleton
declarations.statement:
lemma join_sign_singleton {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    {i j : Fin φs.length} (h : i < j) (hs : (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[i]) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j]))
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [singleton h]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (join (singleton h) φsucΛ).sign = (singleton h).sign * φsucΛ.sign

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_sign_induction
declarations.statement:
lemma join_sign_induction {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) (hc : φsΛ.GradingCompliant) :
    (n : ℕ) → (hn : φsΛ.1.card = n) →
    (join φsΛ φsucΛ).sign = φsΛ.sign * φsucΛ.sign
  | 0, hn => by
    rw [@card_zero_iff_empty] at hn
    subst hn
    simp only [empty_join, sign_empty, one_mul]
    apply sign_congr
    simp
  | Nat.succ n, hn => by
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, φsucΛ', rfl, h1, h2, h3⟩

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_sign
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a grading compliant Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`,
and a Wick contraction `φsucΛ` of `[φsΛ]ᵘᶜ`, the following relation holds
`(join φsΛ φsucΛ).sign = φsΛ.sign * φsucΛ.sign`.

In `φsΛ.sign` the sign is determined by starting with the contracted pair
whose first element occurs at the left-most position. This lemma manifests that this
choice does not matter, and that contracted pairs can be brought together in any order.
declarations.statement:
lemma join_sign {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) (hc : φsΛ.GradingCompliant) :
    (join φsΛ φsucΛ).sign = φsΛ.sign * φsucΛ.sign

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_sign_timeContract
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`,
and a Wick contraction `φsucΛ` of `[φsΛ]ᵘᶜ`,
`(join φsΛ φsucΛ).sign • (join φsΛ φsucΛ).timeContract` is equal to the product of
- `φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract` and
- `φsucΛ.sign • φsucΛ.timeContract`.
declarations.statement:
lemma join_sign_timeContract {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (join φsΛ φsucΛ).sign • (join φsΛ φsucΛ).timeContract.1 =
    (φsΛ.sign • φsΛ.timeContract.1) * (φsucΛ.sign • φsucΛ.timeContract.1)

declarations.name: WickContraction.singleton
declarations.doc: The Wick contraction formed from a single ordered pair.
declarations.statement: def singleton {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) : WickContraction n

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_singleton
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_singleton {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) :
    {i, j} ∈ (singleton hij).1

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_singleton_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_singleton_iff {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) {a : Finset (Fin n)} :
    a ∈ (singleton hij).1 ↔ a = {i, j}

declarations.name: WickContraction.of_singleton_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma of_singleton_eq {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) (a : (singleton hij).1) :
    a = ⟨{i, j}, mem_singleton hij⟩

declarations.name: WickContraction.singleton_prod
declarations.statement:
lemma singleton_prod {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {i j : Fin φs.length} (hij : i < j)
    (f : (singleton hij).1 → M) [CommMonoid M] :
    ∏ a, f a = f ⟨{i,j}, mem_singleton hij⟩

declarations.name: WickContraction.singleton_fstFieldOfContract
declarations.statement:
lemma singleton_fstFieldOfContract {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) :
    (singleton hij).fstFieldOfContract ⟨{i, j}, mem_singleton hij⟩ = i

declarations.name: WickContraction.singleton_sndFieldOfContract
declarations.statement:
lemma singleton_sndFieldOfContract {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) :
    (singleton hij).sndFieldOfContract ⟨{i, j}, mem_singleton hij⟩ = j

declarations.name: WickContraction.singleton_sign_expand
declarations.statement:
lemma singleton_sign_expand {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {i j : Fin φs.length} (hij : i < j) :
    (singleton hij).sign = 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φs[j], 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (singleton hij).signFinset i j⟩)

declarations.name: WickContraction.singleton_getDual?_eq_none_iff_neq
declarations.statement:
lemma singleton_getDual?_eq_none_iff_neq {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) (a : Fin n) :
    (singleton hij).getDual? a = none ↔ (i ≠ a ∧ j ≠ a)

declarations.name: WickContraction.singleton_uncontractedEmd_ne_left
declarations.statement:
lemma singleton_uncontractedEmd_ne_left {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {i j : Fin φs.length} (hij : i < j)
    (a : Fin [singleton hij]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (singleton hij).uncontractedListEmd a ≠ i

declarations.name: WickContraction.singleton_uncontractedEmd_ne_right
declarations.statement:
lemma singleton_uncontractedEmd_ne_right {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {i j : Fin φs.length} (hij : i < j)
    (a : Fin [singleton hij]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    (singleton hij).uncontractedListEmd a ≠ j

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_signFinset
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_signFinset {i j : Fin n} (hij : i < j) (a : Fin n) :
    a ∈ (singleton hij).signFinset i j ↔ i < a ∧ a < j

declarations.name: WickContraction.subContraction_singleton_eq_singleton
declarations.statement:
lemma subContraction_singleton_eq_singleton {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (a : φsΛ.1) : φsΛ.subContraction {a.1} (by simp) =
    singleton (φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract_lt_sndFieldOfContract a)

declarations.name: WickContraction.singleton_timeContract
declarations.statement:
lemma singleton_timeContract {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {i j : Fin φs.length} (hij : i < j) :
    (singleton hij).timeContract =
    ⟨WickAlgebra.timeContract φs[i] φs[j], timeContract_mem_center _ _⟩

declarations.name: WickContraction.singleton_staticContract
declarations.statement:
lemma singleton_staticContract {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {i j : Fin φs.length} (hij : i < j) :
    (singleton hij).staticContract.1 =
    [anPart φs[i], ofFieldOp φs[j]]ₛ

declarations.name: WickContraction.staticContract
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp` and a Wick contraction `φsΛ`, the
element of the center of `𝓕.WickAlgebra`, `φsΛ.staticContract` is defined as the product
of `[anPart φs[j], φs[k]]ₛ` over contracted pairs `{j, k}` in `φsΛ`
with `j < k`.

declarations.name: WickContraction.staticContract_insert_none
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
`𝓕.FieldOp`, and a `i ≤ φs.length`, then the following relation holds:

`(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).staticContract = φsΛ.staticContract`

The proof of this result ultimately is a consequence of definitions.
declarations.statement:
lemma staticContract_insert_none (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).staticContract = φsΛ.staticContract

declarations.name: WickContraction.staticContract_insert_some
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
`𝓕.FieldOp`, a `i ≤ φs.length` and a `k` in `φsΛ.uncontracted`, then
`(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).staticContract` is equal to the product of
- `[anPart φ, φs[k]]ₛ` if `i ≤ k` or `[anPart φs[k], φ]ₛ` if `k < i`
- `φsΛ.staticContract`.

The proof of this result ultimately is a consequence of definitions.
declarations.statement:
lemma staticContract_insert_some
    (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).staticContract =
    (if i < i.succAbove j then
      ⟨[anPart φ, ofFieldOp φs[j.1]]ₛ, superCommute_anPart_ofFieldOp_mem_center _ _⟩
    else ⟨[anPart φs[j.1], ofFieldOp φ]ₛ, superCommute_anPart_ofFieldOp_mem_center _ _⟩) *
    φsΛ.staticContract

declarations.name: WickContraction.staticContract_insert_some_of_lt
declarations.statement:
lemma staticContract_insert_some_of_lt
    (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (hik : i < i.succAbove k) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).staticContract =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (φsΛ.uncontracted.filter (fun x => x < k))⟩)
    • (contractStateAtIndex φ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ ((uncontractedFieldOpEquiv φs φsΛ) (some k)) *
      φsΛ.staticContract)

declarations.name: WickContraction.staticContract_of_not_gradingCompliant
declarations.statement:
lemma staticContract_of_not_gradingCompliant (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (h : ¬ GradingCompliant φs φsΛ) :
    φsΛ.staticContract = 0

declarations.name: WickContraction.subContraction
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick contraction `φsΛ`, and a subset of `φsΛ.1`, the Wick contraction
consisting of contracted pairs within that subset.
declarations.statement:
def subContraction (S : Finset (Finset (Fin φs.length))) (ha : S ⊆ φsΛ.1) :
    WickContraction φs.length

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_of_mem_subContraction
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_of_mem_subContraction {S : Finset (Finset (Fin φs.length))} {hs : S ⊆ φsΛ.1}
    {a : Finset (Fin φs.length)} (ha : a ∈ (φsΛ.subContraction S hs).1) : a ∈ φsΛ.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.quotContraction
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick contraction `φsΛ`, and a subset `S` of `φsΛ.1`, the Wick contraction
on the uncontracted list `[φsΛ.subContraction S ha]ᵘᶜ`
consisting of the remaining contracted pairs of `φsΛ` not in `S`.
declarations.statement:
def quotContraction (S : Finset (Finset (Fin φs.length))) (ha : S ⊆ φsΛ.1) :
    WickContraction [φsΛ.subContraction S ha]ᵘᶜ.length

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_of_mem_quotContraction
WickContraction.mem_subContraction_or_quotContraction
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_subContraction_or_quotContraction {S : Finset (Finset (Fin φs.length))} {hs : S ⊆ φsΛ.1}
    {a : Finset (Fin φs.length)} (ha : a ∈ φsΛ.1) :
    a ∈ (φsΛ.subContraction S hs).1 ∨
    ∃ a', Finset.map uncontractedListEmd a' = a ∧ a' ∈ (quotContraction S hs).1

declarations.name: WickContraction.subContraction_uncontractedList_get
WickContraction.subContraction_fstFieldOfContract
declarations.statement:
lemma subContraction_fstFieldOfContract {S : Finset (Finset (Fin φs.length))} {hs : S ⊆ φsΛ.1}
    (a : (subContraction S hs).1) :
    (subContraction S hs).fstFieldOfContract a =
    φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract ⟨a.1, mem_of_mem_subContraction a.2⟩

declarations.name: WickContraction.subContraction_sndFieldOfContract
declarations.statement:
lemma subContraction_sndFieldOfContract {S : Finset (Finset (Fin φs.length))} {hs : S ⊆ φsΛ.1}
    (a : (subContraction S hs).1) :
    (subContraction S hs).sndFieldOfContract a =
    φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract ⟨a.1, mem_of_mem_subContraction a.2⟩

declarations.name: WickContraction.quotContraction_fstFieldOfContract_uncontractedListEmd
declarations.statement:
lemma quotContraction_fstFieldOfContract_uncontractedListEmd {S : Finset (Finset (Fin φs.length))}
    {hs : S ⊆ φsΛ.1} (a : (quotContraction S hs).1) :
    uncontractedListEmd ((quotContraction S hs).fstFieldOfContract a) =
    (φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract
    ⟨Finset.map uncontractedListEmd a.1, mem_of_mem_quotContraction a.2⟩)

declarations.name: WickContraction.quotContraction_sndFieldOfContract_uncontractedListEmd
declarations.statement:
lemma quotContraction_sndFieldOfContract_uncontractedListEmd {S : Finset (Finset (Fin φs.length))}
    {hs : S ⊆ φsΛ.1} (a : (quotContraction S hs).1) :
    uncontractedListEmd ((quotContraction S hs).sndFieldOfContract a) =
    (φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract
      ⟨Finset.map uncontractedListEmd a.1, mem_of_mem_quotContraction a.2⟩)

declarations.name: WickContraction.quotContraction_gradingCompliant
WickContraction.mem_quotContraction_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_quotContraction_iff {S : Finset (Finset (Fin φs.length))} {hs : S ⊆ φsΛ.1}
    {a : Finset (Fin [φsΛ.subContraction S hs]ᵘᶜ.length)} :
    a ∈ (quotContraction S hs).1 ↔ a.map uncontractedListEmd ∈ φsΛ.1
    ∧ a.map uncontractedListEmd ∉ (subContraction S hs).1

declarations.name: WickContraction.EqTimeOnly
declarations.doc:
The condition on a Wick contraction which is true iff and only if every contraction
is between two fields of equal time.
declarations.statement: def EqTimeOnly {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) : Prop

instance {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    Decidable (EqTimeOnly φsΛ)

declarations.name: WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.timeOrderRel_of_eqTimeOnly_pair
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrderRel_of_eqTimeOnly_pair {i j : Fin φs.length} (h : {i, j} ∈ φsΛ.1)
    (hc : EqTimeOnly φsΛ) :
    timeOrderRel φs[i] φs[j]

declarations.name: WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.timeOrderRel_both_of_eqTimeOnly
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrderRel_both_of_eqTimeOnly {i j : Fin φs.length} (h : {i, j} ∈ φsΛ.1)
    (hc : EqTimeOnly φsΛ) :
    timeOrderRel φs[i] φs[j] ∧ timeOrderRel φs[j] φs[i]

declarations.name: WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.eqTimeOnly_iff_forall_finset
declarations.statement:
lemma eqTimeOnly_iff_forall_finset {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    φsΛ.EqTimeOnly ↔ ∀ (a : φsΛ.1),
      timeOrderRel (φs[φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract a]) (φs[φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a])
      ∧ timeOrderRel (φs[φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract a]) (φs[φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract a])

declarations.name: WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.empty_mem
declarations.statement: lemma empty_mem {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} : empty (n := φs.length).EqTimeOnly

declarations.name: WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.staticContract_eq_timeContract_of_eqTimeOnly
declarations.doc:
Let `φs` be a list of `𝓕.FieldOp` and `φsΛ` a `WickContraction` of `φs` within
which every contraction involves two `𝓕.FieldOp`s that have the same time, then
`φsΛ.staticContract = φsΛ.timeContract`.
declarations.statement:
lemma staticContract_eq_timeContract_of_eqTimeOnly (h : φsΛ.EqTimeOnly) :
    φsΛ.staticContract = φsΛ.timeContract

declarations.name: WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.eqTimeOnly_congr
declarations.statement:
lemma eqTimeOnly_congr {φs φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : φs = φs') (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    (congr (by simp [h]) φsΛ).EqTimeOnly (φs := φs') ↔ φsΛ.EqTimeOnly

declarations.name: WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.quotContraction_eqTimeOnly
WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.exists_join_singleton_of_card_ge_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_join_singleton_of_card_ge_zero {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (h : 0 < φsΛ.1.card) (h1 : φsΛ.EqTimeOnly) :
    ∃ (i j : Fin φs.length) (h : i < j) (φsucΛ : WickContraction [singleton h]ᵘᶜ.length),
    φsΛ = join (singleton h) φsucΛ ∧ (timeOrderRel φs[i] φs[j] ∧ timeOrderRel φs[j] φs[i])
    ∧ φsucΛ.EqTimeOnly ∧ φsucΛ.1.card + 1 = φsΛ.1.card

declarations.name: WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.timeOrder_timeContract_mul_of_eqTimeOnly_mid_induction
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_timeContract_mul_of_eqTimeOnly_mid_induction {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (hl : φsΛ.EqTimeOnly) (a b: 𝓕.WickAlgebra) : (n : ℕ) → (hn : φsΛ.1.card = n) →
    𝓣(a * φsΛ.timeContract.1 * b) = φsΛ.timeContract.1 * 𝓣(a * b)
  | 0, hn => by
    rw [@card_zero_iff_empty] at hn
    subst hn
    simp
  | Nat.succ n, hn => by
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, φsucΛ, rfl, h2, h3, h4⟩

declarations.name: WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.timeOrder_timeContract_mul_of_eqTimeOnly_mid
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_timeContract_mul_of_eqTimeOnly_mid {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (hl : φsΛ.EqTimeOnly) (a b : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣(a * φsΛ.timeContract.1 * b) = φsΛ.timeContract.1 * 𝓣(a * b)

declarations.name: WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.timeOrder_timeContract_mul_of_eqTimeOnly_left
declarations.doc:
Let `φs` be a list of `𝓕.FieldOp`, `φsΛ` a `WickContraction` of `φs` within
which every contraction involves two `𝓕.FieldOp`s that have the same time and
`b` a general element in `𝓕.WickAlgebra`. Then
`𝓣(φsΛ.timeContract.1 * b) = φsΛ.timeContract.1 * 𝓣(b)`.

This follows from properties of orderings and the ideal defining `𝓕.WickAlgebra`.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_timeContract_mul_of_eqTimeOnly_left {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (hl : φsΛ.EqTimeOnly) (b : 𝓕.WickAlgebra) :
    𝓣(φsΛ.timeContract.1 * b) = φsΛ.timeContract.1 * 𝓣(b)

declarations.name: WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.exists_join_singleton_of_not_eqTimeOnly
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_join_singleton_of_not_eqTimeOnly {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp}
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (h1 : ¬ φsΛ.EqTimeOnly) :
    ∃ (i j : Fin φs.length) (h : i < j) (φsucΛ : WickContraction [singleton h]ᵘᶜ.length),
    φsΛ = join (singleton h) φsucΛ ∧ (¬ timeOrderRel φs[i] φs[j] ∨ ¬ timeOrderRel φs[j] φs[i])

declarations.name: WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.timeOrder_timeContract_of_not_eqTimeOnly
WickContraction.EqTimeOnly.timeOrder_staticContract_of_not_mem
declarations.doc:
Let `φs` be a list of `𝓕.FieldOp` and `φsΛ` a `WickContraction` with
at least one contraction between `𝓕.FieldOp` that do not have the same time. Then
`𝓣(φsΛ.staticContract.1) = 0`.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeOrder_staticContract_of_not_mem {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (hl : ¬ φsΛ.EqTimeOnly) : 𝓣(φsΛ.staticContract.1) = 0

declarations.name: WickContraction.HaveEqTime
declarations.doc:
The condition on a Wick contraction which is true if it has at least one contraction
which is between two equal time fields.
declarations.statement: def HaveEqTime {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) : Prop

noncomputable instance {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    Decidable (HaveEqTime φsΛ)

declarations.name: WickContraction.haveEqTime_iff_finset
declarations.statement:
lemma haveEqTime_iff_finset {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    HaveEqTime φsΛ ↔ ∃ (a : Finset (Fin φs.length)) (h : a ∈ φsΛ.1),
      timeOrderRel φs[φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract ⟨a, h⟩] φs[φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract ⟨a, h⟩]
    ∧ timeOrderRel φs[φsΛ.sndFieldOfContract ⟨a, h⟩] φs[φsΛ.fstFieldOfContract ⟨a, h⟩]

declarations.name: WickContraction.empty_not_haveEqTime
declarations.statement:
lemma empty_not_haveEqTime {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} :
    ¬ HaveEqTime (empty : WickContraction φs.length)

declarations.name: WickContraction.eqTimeContractSet
declarations.doc: Given a Wick contraction the subset of contracted pairs between equal time fields.
declarations.statement:
def eqTimeContractSet {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    Finset (Finset (Fin φs.length))

declarations.name: WickContraction.eqTimeContractSet_subset
declarations.statement:
lemma eqTimeContractSet_subset {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    eqTimeContractSet φsΛ ⊆ φsΛ.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_of_mem_eqTimeContractSet
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_of_mem_eqTimeContractSet{φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length}
    {a : Finset (Fin φs.length)} (h : a ∈ eqTimeContractSet φsΛ) : a ∈ φsΛ.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.join_eqTimeContractSet
declarations.statement:
lemma join_eqTimeContractSet {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    eqTimeContractSet (join φsΛ φsucΛ) = φsΛ.eqTimeContractSet ∪
    φsucΛ.eqTimeContractSet.map (Finset.mapEmbedding uncontractedListEmd).toEmbedding

declarations.name: WickContraction.eqTimeContractSet_of_not_haveEqTime
declarations.statement:
lemma eqTimeContractSet_of_not_haveEqTime {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length}
    (h : ¬ HaveEqTime φsΛ) : eqTimeContractSet φsΛ = ∅

declarations.name: WickContraction.eqTimeContractSet_of_mem_eqTimeOnly
declarations.statement:
lemma eqTimeContractSet_of_mem_eqTimeOnly {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length}
    (h : φsΛ.EqTimeOnly) : eqTimeContractSet φsΛ = φsΛ.1

declarations.name: WickContraction.subContraction_eqTimeContractSet_eqTimeOnly
WickContraction.pair_mem_eqTimeContractSet_iff
WickContraction.subContraction_eqTimeContractSet_not_empty_of_haveEqTime
declarations.statement:
lemma subContraction_eqTimeContractSet_not_empty_of_haveEqTime
    {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (h : HaveEqTime φsΛ) :
    φsΛ.subContraction (eqTimeContractSet φsΛ) (eqTimeContractSet_subset φsΛ) ≠ empty

declarations.name: WickContraction.quotContraction_eqTimeContractSet_not_haveEqTime
WickContraction.join_haveEqTime_of_eqTimeOnly_nonEmpty
declarations.statement:
lemma join_haveEqTime_of_eqTimeOnly_nonEmpty {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length)
    (h1 : φsΛ.EqTimeOnly) (h2 : φsΛ ≠ empty)
    (φsucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) :
    HaveEqTime (join φsΛ φsucΛ)

declarations.name: WickContraction.hasEqTimeEquiv_ext_sigma
declarations.statement:
lemma hasEqTimeEquiv_ext_sigma {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {x1 x2 :
    Σ (φsΛ : {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length // φsΛ.EqTimeOnly ∧ φsΛ ≠ empty}),
    {φssucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ.1]ᵘᶜ.length // ¬ HaveEqTime φssucΛ}}
    (h1 : x1.1.1 = x2.1.1) (h2 : x1.2.1 = congr (by simp [h1]) x2.2.1) : x1 = x2

declarations.name: WickContraction.hasEqTimeEquiv
declarations.doc:
The equivalence which separates a Wick contraction which has an equal time contraction
into a non-empty contraction only between equal-time fields and a Wick contraction which
does not have equal time contractions.

declarations.name: WickContraction.sum_haveEqTime
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_haveEqTime (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (f : WickContraction φs.length → M) [AddCommMonoid M]:
  ∑ (φsΛ : {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length // HaveEqTime φsΛ}), f φsΛ =
  ∑ (φsΛ : {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length // φsΛ.EqTimeOnly ∧ φsΛ ≠ empty}),
  ∑ (φssucΛ : {φssucΛ : WickContraction [φsΛ.1]ᵘᶜ.length // ¬ HaveEqTime φssucΛ}),
    f (join φsΛ.1 φssucΛ.1)

declarations.name: WickContraction.timeContract
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp` and a Wick contraction `φsΛ` the
element of the center of `𝓕.WickAlgebra`, `φsΛ.timeContract` is defined as the product
of `timeContract φs[j] φs[k]` over contracted pairs `{j, k}` in `φsΛ`
with `j < k`.

declarations.name: WickContraction.timeContract_insert_none
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
`𝓕.FieldOp`, and a `i ≤ φs.length` the following relation holds

`(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).timeContract = φsΛ.timeContract`

The proof of this result ultimately is a consequence of definitions.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_insert_none (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i none).timeContract = φsΛ.timeContract

declarations.name: WickContraction.timeContract_insertAndContract_some
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
`𝓕.FieldOp`, a `i ≤ φs.length` and a `k` in `φsΛ.uncontracted`, then
`(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).timeContract` is equal to the product of
- `timeContract φ φs[k]` if `i ≤ k` or `timeContract φs[k] φ` if `k < i`
- `φsΛ.timeContract`.

The proof of this result ultimately is a consequence of definitions.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_insertAndContract_some
    (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (j : φsΛ.uncontracted) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some j)).timeContract =
    (if i < i.succAbove j then
      ⟨WickAlgebra.timeContract φ φs[j.1], timeContract_mem_center _ _⟩
    else ⟨WickAlgebra.timeContract φs[j.1] φ, timeContract_mem_center _ _⟩) *
    φsΛ.timeContract

declarations.name: WickContraction.timeContract_empty
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_empty (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) :
    (@empty φs.length).timeContract = 1

declarations.name: WickContraction.timeContract_insert_some_of_lt
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
`𝓕.FieldOp`, a `i ≤ φs.length` and a `k` in `φsΛ.uncontracted` such that `i ≤ k`, with the
condition that `φ` has greater or equal time to `φs[k]`, then
`(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).timeContract` is equal to the product of
- `[anPart φ, φs[k]]ₛ`
- `φsΛ.timeContract`
- two copies of the exchange sign of `φ` with the uncontracted fields in `φ₀…φₖ₋₁`.
  These two exchange signs cancel each other out but are included for convenience.

The proof of this result ultimately is a consequence of definitions and
`timeContract_of_timeOrderRel`.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_insert_some_of_lt
    (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (ht : 𝓕.timeOrderRel φ φs[k.1]) (hik : i < i.succAbove k) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).timeContract =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (φsΛ.uncontracted.filter (fun x => x < k))⟩)
    • (contractStateAtIndex φ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ ((uncontractedFieldOpEquiv φs φsΛ) (some k)) *
      φsΛ.timeContract)

declarations.name: WickContraction.timeContract_insert_some_of_not_lt
declarations.doc:
For a list `φs = φ₀…φₙ` of `𝓕.FieldOp`, a Wick contraction `φsΛ` of `φs`, an element `φ` of
`𝓕.FieldOp`, a `i ≤ φs.length` and a `k` in `φsΛ.uncontracted` such that `k < i`, with the
condition that `φs[k]` does not have time greater or equal to `φ`, then
`(φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).timeContract` is equal to the product of
- `[anPart φ, φs[k]]ₛ`
- `φsΛ.timeContract`
- the exchange sign of `φ` with the uncontracted fields in `φ₀…φₖ₋₁`.
- the exchange sign of `φ` with the uncontracted fields in `φ₀…φₖ`.

The proof of this result ultimately is a consequence of definitions and
`timeContract_of_not_timeOrderRel_expand`.
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_insert_some_of_not_lt
    (φ : 𝓕.FieldOp) (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (i : Fin φs.length.succ) (k : φsΛ.uncontracted)
    (ht : ¬ 𝓕.timeOrderRel φs[k.1] φ) (hik : ¬ i < i.succAbove k) :
    (φsΛ ↩Λ φ i (some k)).timeContract =
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ⟨φs.get, (φsΛ.uncontracted.filter (fun x => x ≤ k))⟩)
    • (contractStateAtIndex φ [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ
      ((uncontractedFieldOpEquiv φs φsΛ) (some k)) * φsΛ.timeContract)

declarations.name: WickContraction.timeContract_of_not_gradingCompliant
declarations.statement:
lemma timeContract_of_not_gradingCompliant (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (h : ¬ GradingCompliant φs φsΛ) :
    φsΛ.timeContract = 0

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontracted
declarations.doc:
For a Wick contraction `c`, `c.uncontracted` is defined as the finset of elements of `Fin n`
which are not in any contracted pair.
declarations.statement: def uncontracted : Finset (Fin n)

declarations.name: WickContraction.congr_uncontracted
declarations.statement:
lemma congr_uncontracted {n m : ℕ} (c : WickContraction n) (h : n = m) :
    (c.congr h).uncontracted = Finset.map (finCongr h).toEmbedding c.uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_eq_none_iff_mem_uncontracted
declarations.statement:
lemma getDual?_eq_none_iff_mem_uncontracted (i : Fin n) :
    c.getDual? i = none ↔ i ∈ c.uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedCongr
declarations.doc: The equivalence of `Option c.uncontracted` for two propositionally equal Wick contractions.
declarations.statement:
def uncontractedCongr {c c': WickContraction n} (h : c = c') :
    Option c.uncontracted ≃ Option c'.uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedCongr_none
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedCongr_none {c c': WickContraction n} (h : c = c') :
    (uncontractedCongr h) none = none

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedCongr_some
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedCongr_some {c c': WickContraction n} (h : c = c') (i : c.uncontracted) :
    (uncontractedCongr h) (some i) = some (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (by rw [h]; simp) i)

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_uncontracted_iff_not_contracted
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_uncontracted_iff_not_contracted (i : Fin n) :
    i ∈ c.uncontracted ↔ ∀ p ∈ c.1, i ∉ p

declarations.name: WickContraction.mem_uncontracted_empty
declarations.statement: lemma mem_uncontracted_empty (i : Fin n) : i ∈ empty.uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.getDual?_empty_eq_none
declarations.statement: lemma getDual?_empty_eq_none (i : Fin n) : empty.getDual? i = none

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontracted_empty
declarations.statement: lemma uncontracted_empty {n : ℕ} : (@empty n).uncontracted = Finset.univ

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontracted_card_le
declarations.statement: lemma uncontracted_card_le (c : WickContraction n) : c.uncontracted.card ≤ n

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontracted_card_eq_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontracted_card_eq_iff (c : WickContraction n) :
    c.uncontracted.card = n ↔ c = empty
