declarations.name: WickContraction.fin_list_sorted_monotone_sorted
declarations.statement:
lemma fin_list_sorted_monotone_sorted {n m : ℕ} (l: List (Fin n)) (hl : l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·))
    (f : Fin n → Fin m) (hf : StrictMono f) : (List.map f l).Pairwise (· ≤ ·)

declarations.name: WickContraction.fin_list_sorted_succAboveEmb_sorted
declarations.statement:
lemma fin_list_sorted_succAboveEmb_sorted (l: List (Fin n)) (hl : l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·))
    (i : Fin n.succ) : ((List.map i.succAboveEmb l)).Pairwise (· ≤ ·)

declarations.name: WickContraction.fin_finset_sort_map_monotone
declarations.statement:
lemma fin_finset_sort_map_monotone {n m : ℕ} (a : Finset (Fin n)) (f : Fin n ↪ Fin m)
    (hf : StrictMono f) : (a.sort (· ≤ ·)).map f =
    ((a.map f).sort (· ≤ ·))

declarations.name: WickContraction.fin_list_sorted_split
declarations.statement:
lemma fin_list_sorted_split :
    (l : List (Fin n)) → (hl : l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) → (i : ℕ) →
    l = l.filter (fun x => x.1 < i) ++ l.filter (fun x => i ≤ x.1)

declarations.name: WickContraction.fin_list_sorted_indexOf_filter_le_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma fin_list_sorted_indexOf_filter_le_mem :
    (l : List (Fin n)) → (hl : l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) → (i : Fin n) →
    (hl : i ∈ l) →
    List.idxOf i (List.filter (fun x => decide (↑i ≤ ↑x)) l) = 0

declarations.name: WickContraction.fin_list_sorted_indexOf_mem
declarations.statement:
lemma fin_list_sorted_indexOf_mem :
    (l : List (Fin n)) → (hl : l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) → (i : Fin n) →
    (hi : i ∈ l) →
    l.idxOf i = (l.filter (fun x => x.1 < i.1)).length

declarations.name: WickContraction.orderedInsert_of_fin_list_sorted
declarations.statement:
lemma orderedInsert_of_fin_list_sorted :
    (l : List (Fin n)) → (hl : l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) → (i : Fin n) →
    List.orderedInsert (· ≤ ·) i l = l.filter (fun x => x.1 < i.1) ++
    i :: l.filter (fun x => i.1 ≤ x.1)

declarations.name: WickContraction.orderedInsert_eq_insertIdx_of_fin_list_sorted
declarations.statement:
lemma orderedInsert_eq_insertIdx_of_fin_list_sorted (l : List (Fin n)) (hl : l.Pairwise (· ≤ ·))
    (i : Fin n) :
    List.orderedInsert (· ≤ ·) i l = l.insertIdx (l.filter (fun x => x.1 < i.1)).length i

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick contraction `c`, the ordered list of elements of `Fin n` which are not contracted,
i.e. do not appear anywhere in `c.1`.
declarations.statement: def uncontractedList : List (Fin n)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_mem_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_mem_iff (i : Fin n) :
    i ∈ c.uncontractedList ↔ i ∈ c.uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_empty
declarations.statement: lemma uncontractedList_empty : (empty (n := n)).uncontractedList = List.finRange n

declarations.name: WickContraction.nil_zero_uncontractedList
declarations.statement: lemma nil_zero_uncontractedList : (empty (n := 0)).uncontractedList = []

declarations.name: WickContraction.congr_uncontractedList
declarations.statement:
lemma congr_uncontractedList {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) (c : WickContraction n) :
    ((congr h) c).uncontractedList = List.map (finCongr h) c.uncontractedList

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_get_mem_uncontracted
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_get_mem_uncontracted (i : Fin c.uncontractedList.length) :
    c.uncontractedList.get i ∈ c.uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_sorted
declarations.statement: lemma uncontractedList_sorted : List.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) c.uncontractedList

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_sorted_lt
declarations.statement: lemma uncontractedList_sorted_lt : List.Pairwise (· < ·) c.uncontractedList

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_nodup
declarations.statement: lemma uncontractedList_nodup : c.uncontractedList.Nodup

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_toFinset
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_toFinset (c : WickContraction n) :
    c.uncontractedList.toFinset = c.uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_eq_sort
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_eq_sort (c : WickContraction n) :
    c.uncontractedList = c.uncontracted.sort (· ≤ ·)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_length_eq_card
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_length_eq_card (c : WickContraction n) :
    c.uncontractedList.length = c.uncontracted.card

declarations.name: WickContraction.filter_uncontractedList
declarations.statement:
lemma filter_uncontractedList (c : WickContraction n) (p : Fin n → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    (c.uncontractedList.filter p) = (c.uncontracted.filter p).sort (· ≤ ·)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedIndexEquiv
declarations.doc:
The equivalence between the positions of `c.uncontractedList` i.e. elements of
`Fin (c.uncontractedList).length` and the finite set `c.uncontracted` considered as a finite type.
declarations.statement:
def uncontractedIndexEquiv (c : WickContraction n) :
    Fin (c.uncontractedList).length ≃ c.uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_getElem_uncontractedIndexEquiv_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_getElem_uncontractedIndexEquiv_symm (k : c.uncontracted) :
    c.uncontractedList[(c.uncontractedIndexEquiv.symm k).val] = k

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedIndexEquiv_symm_eq_filter_length
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedIndexEquiv_symm_eq_filter_length (k : c.uncontracted) :
    (c.uncontractedIndexEquiv.symm k).val =
    (List.filter (fun i => i < k.val) c.uncontractedList).length

declarations.name: WickContraction.take_uncontractedIndexEquiv_symm
declarations.statement:
lemma take_uncontractedIndexEquiv_symm (k : c.uncontracted) :
    c.uncontractedList.take (c.uncontractedIndexEquiv.symm k).val =
    c.uncontractedList.filter (fun i => i < k.val)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedListGet
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick Contraction `φsΛ` of a list `φs` of `𝓕.FieldOp`. The list
`φsΛ.uncontractedListGet` of `𝓕.FieldOp` is defined as the list `φs` with
all contracted positions removed, leaving the uncontracted `𝓕.FieldOp`.

The notation `[φsΛ]ᵘᶜ` is used for `φsΛ.uncontractedListGet`.
declarations.statement:
def uncontractedListGet {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    List 𝓕.FieldOp

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedListGet_empty
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedListGet_empty {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} :
    (empty (n := φs.length)).uncontractedListGet = φs

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedFieldOpEquiv
declarations.doc:
The equivalence between the type `Option c.uncontracted` for `WickContraction φs.length` and
`Option (Fin (c.uncontractedList.map φs.get).length)`, that is optional positions of
`c.uncontractedList.map φs.get` induced by `uncontractedIndexEquiv`.
declarations.statement:
def uncontractedFieldOpEquiv (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    Option φsΛ.uncontracted ≃ Option (Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedFieldOpEquiv_none
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedFieldOpEquiv_none (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    (uncontractedFieldOpEquiv φs φsΛ).toFun none = none

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedFieldOpEquiv_list_sum
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedFieldOpEquiv_list_sum [AddCommMonoid α] (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp)
    (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) (f : Option (Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) → α) :
    ∑ (i : Option (Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length)), f i =
    ∑ (i : Option φsΛ.uncontracted), f (φsΛ.uncontractedFieldOpEquiv φs i)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedListEmd
declarations.doc: The embedding of `Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length` into `Fin φs.length`.
declarations.statement:
def uncontractedListEmd {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length} :
    Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length ↪ Fin φs.length

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedListEmd_congr
WickContraction.uncontractedListEmd_toFun_eq_get
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedListEmd_toFun_eq_get (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length) :
    (uncontractedListEmd (φsΛ := φsΛ)).toFun =
    φsΛ.uncontractedList.get ∘ (finCongr (by simp [uncontractedListGet]))

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedListEmd_strictMono
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedListEmd_strictMono {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length}
    {i j : Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length} (h : i < j) : uncontractedListEmd i < uncontractedListEmd j

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedListEmd_mem_uncontracted
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedListEmd_mem_uncontracted {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length}
    (i : Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) : uncontractedListEmd i ∈ φsΛ.uncontracted

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedListEmd_surjective_mem_uncontracted
WickContraction.uncontractedListEmd_finset_disjoint_left
WickContraction.uncontractedListEmd_finset_not_mem
WickContraction.getElem_uncontractedListEmd
declarations.statement:
lemma getElem_uncontractedListEmd {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} {φsΛ : WickContraction φs.length}
    (k : Fin [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ.length) : φs[(uncontractedListEmd k).1] = [φsΛ]ᵘᶜ[k.1]

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedListEmd_empty
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedListEmd_empty {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} :
    (empty (n := φs.length)).uncontractedListEmd = (finCongr (by simp)).toEmbedding

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_sorted
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_sorted (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    ((List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList)).Pairwise (· ≤ ·)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_nodup
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_nodup (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    ((List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList)).Nodup

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_succAbove_orderedInsert_nodup
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_succAbove_orderedInsert_nodup (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (List.orderedInsert (· ≤ ·) i (List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList)).Nodup

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_succAbove_orderedInsert_sorted
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_succAbove_orderedInsert_sorted (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (List.orderedInsert (· ≤ ·) i
      (List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList)).Pairwise (· ≤ ·)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_succAbove_orderedInsert_toFinset
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_succAbove_orderedInsert_toFinset (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (List.orderedInsert (· ≤ ·) i (List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList)).toFinset =
    (Insert.insert i (Finset.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontracted))

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_succAbove_orderedInsert_eq_sort
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_succAbove_orderedInsert_eq_sort (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (List.orderedInsert (· ≤ ·) i (List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList)) =
    (Insert.insert i (Finset.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontracted)).sort (· ≤ ·)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_extractEquiv_symm_none
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_extractEquiv_symm_none (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    ((extractEquiv i).symm ⟨c, none⟩).uncontractedList =
    List.orderedInsert (· ≤ ·) i (List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_eraseIdx_toFinset
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_eraseIdx_toFinset (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k < c.uncontractedList.length) :
    ((List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList).eraseIdx k).toFinset =
    (c.uncontracted.map i.succAboveEmb).erase (i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList[k])

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_eraseIdx_sorted
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_eraseIdx_sorted (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (k: ℕ) : ((List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList).eraseIdx k).Pairwise (· ≤ ·)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_eraseIdx_nodup
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_eraseIdx_nodup (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) (k: ℕ) :
    ((List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList).eraseIdx k).Nodup

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_eraseIdx_eq_sort
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_eraseIdx_eq_sort (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k < c.uncontractedList.length) :
    ((List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList).eraseIdx k) =
    ((c.uncontracted.map i.succAboveEmb).erase
    (i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList[k])).sort (· ≤ ·)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_extractEquiv_symm_some
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_extractEquiv_symm_some (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ)
    (k : c.uncontracted) : ((extractEquiv i).symm ⟨c, some k⟩).uncontractedList =
    ((c.uncontractedList).map i.succAboveEmb).eraseIdx (c.uncontractedIndexEquiv.symm k)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_toFinset
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedList_succAboveEmb_toFinset (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList).toFinset =
    (Finset.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontracted)

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedListOrderPos
declarations.doc:
Given a Wick contraction `c : WickContraction n` and a `Fin n.succ`, the number of elements
of `c.uncontractedList` which are less than `i`.
Suppose we want to insert into `c` at position `i`, then this is the position we would
need to insert into `c.uncontractedList`.
declarations.statement: def uncontractedListOrderPos (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) : ℕ

declarations.name: WickContraction.uncontractedListOrderPos_le_length
declarations.statement:
lemma uncontractedListOrderPos_le_length (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    c.uncontractedListOrderPos i ≤ c.uncontractedList.length

declarations.name: WickContraction.take_uncontractedListOrderPos_eq_filter
declarations.statement:
lemma take_uncontractedListOrderPos_eq_filter (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (c.uncontractedList.take (c.uncontractedListOrderPos i)) =
    c.uncontractedList.filter (fun x => x.1 < i.1)

declarations.name: WickContraction.take_uncontractedListOrderPos_eq_filter_sort
declarations.statement:
lemma take_uncontractedListOrderPos_eq_filter_sort (c : WickContraction n) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (c.uncontractedList.take (c.uncontractedListOrderPos i)) =
    (c.uncontracted.filter (fun x => x.1 < i.1)).sort (· ≤ ·)

declarations.name: WickContraction.orderedInsert_succAboveEmb_uncontractedList_eq_insertIdx
declarations.statement:
lemma orderedInsert_succAboveEmb_uncontractedList_eq_insertIdx (c : WickContraction n)
    (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (List.orderedInsert (· ≤ ·) i (List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList)) =
    (List.map i.succAboveEmb c.uncontractedList).insertIdx (uncontractedListOrderPos c i) i

modules.title: Anomaly cancellation of a theory with a pure U(1)-gauge group
modules.doc:
In a pure U(1) gauge theory with `n` Weyl fermions carrying charges `xᵢ` the anomaly cancellation
conditions (ACCs) which must be satisfied for a consistent gauge theory correspond to:

- The linear ACC: `∑ xᵢ = 0`
- The cubic ACC: `∑ xᵢ³ = 0`

The charges `xᵢ` have rational fractions with one another, here they are specified as
rational numbers.

declarations.name: PureU1.PureU1Charges
declarations.doc: The vector space of charges.
declarations.statement: def PureU1Charges (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemCharges

declarations.name: PureU1.accGrav
declarations.doc: The gravitational anomaly.
declarations.statement: def accGrav (n : ℕ) : ((PureU1Charges n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)

declarations.name: PureU1.accCubeTriLinSymm
declarations.doc: The symmetric trilinear form used to define the cubic anomaly.
declarations.statement: def accCubeTriLinSymm {n : ℕ} : TriLinearSymm (PureU1Charges n).Charges

declarations.name: PureU1.accCube
declarations.doc: The cubic anomaly equation.
declarations.statement: def accCube (n : ℕ) : HomogeneousCubic ((PureU1Charges n).Charges)

declarations.name: PureU1.accCube_explicit
declarations.doc:
The cubic ACC for the pure-`U(1)` anomaly equations is equal to the sum of the cubed
charges.
declarations.statement:
lemma accCube_explicit (n : ℕ) (S : (PureU1Charges n).Charges) :
    accCube n S = ∑ i : Fin n, S i ^ 3

declarations.name: PureU1
declarations.doc: The ACC system for a pure $U(1)$ gauge theory with $n$ fermions.
declarations.statement: def PureU1 (n : ℕ) : ACCSystem

declarations.name: pureU1EqCharges
declarations.doc: An equivalence of vector spaces of charges when the number of fermions is equal.
declarations.statement:
def pureU1EqCharges {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges ≃ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 m).Charges

declarations.name: pureU1_linear
declarations.doc: A solution to the pure U(1) accs satisfies the linear ACCs.
declarations.statement:
lemma pureU1_linear {n : ℕ} (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols) :
    ∑ (i : Fin n), S.val i = 0

declarations.name: pureU1_cube
declarations.doc: A solution to the pure U(1) accs satisfies the cubic ACCs.
declarations.statement:
lemma pureU1_cube {n : ℕ} (S : (PureU1 n).Sols) :
    ∑ i, (S.val i) ^ 3 = 0

declarations.name: pureU1_last
declarations.doc:
The last charge of a solution to the linear ACCs is equal to the negation of the sum
of the other charges.
declarations.statement:
lemma pureU1_last {n : ℕ} (S : (PureU1 n.succ).LinSols) :
    S.val (Fin.last n) = - ∑ i : Fin n, S.val i.castSucc

declarations.name: pureU1_anomalyFree_ext
declarations.doc:
Two solutions to the Linear ACCs for `n.succ` are equal if their first `n` charges are
equal.
declarations.statement:
lemma pureU1_anomalyFree_ext {n : ℕ} {S T : (PureU1 n.succ).LinSols}
    (h : ∀ (i : Fin n), S.val i.castSucc = T.val i.castSucc) : S = T

declarations.name: PureU1.sum_of_charges
declarations.doc:
The `j`th charge of a sum of pure-`U(1)` charges is equal to the sum of
their `j`th charges.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_of_charges {n : ℕ} (f : Fin k → (PureU1 n).Charges) (j : Fin n) :
    (∑ i : Fin k, (f i)) j = ∑ i : Fin k, (f i) j

declarations.name: PureU1.sum_of_anomaly_free_linear
declarations.doc:
The `j`th charge of a sum of solutions to the linear ACC is equal to the sum of
their `j`th charges.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_of_anomaly_free_linear {n : ℕ} (f : Fin k → (PureU1 n).LinSols) (j : Fin n) :
    (∑ i : Fin k, (f i)).1 j = (∑ i : Fin k, (f i).1 j)

modules.title: Basis of `LinSols`
modules.doc: We give a basis of vector space `LinSols`, and find the rank thereof.

declarations.name: PureU1.BasisLinear.asCharges
declarations.doc:
The basis elements as charges, defined to have a `1` in the `j`th position and a `-1` in the
last position.
declarations.statement: def asCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 n.succ).Charges

declarations.name: PureU1.BasisLinear.asCharges_eq_castSucc
declarations.statement:
lemma asCharges_eq_castSucc (j : Fin n) :
    asCharges j (Fin.castSucc j) = 1

declarations.name: PureU1.BasisLinear.asCharges_ne_castSucc
declarations.statement:
lemma asCharges_ne_castSucc {k j : Fin n} (h : k ≠ j) :
    asCharges k j.castSucc = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.BasisLinear.asLinSols
declarations.doc: The basis elements as `LinSols`.
declarations.statement: def asLinSols (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 n.succ).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.BasisLinear.sum_of_vectors
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_of_vectors {n : ℕ} (f : Fin k → (PureU1 n).LinSols) (j : Fin n) :
    (∑ i : Fin k, (f i)).1 j = (∑ i : Fin k, (f i).1 j)

declarations.name: PureU1.BasisLinear.coordinateMap
declarations.doc: The coordinate map for the basis.
declarations.statement: def coordinateMap : (PureU1 n.succ).LinSols ≃ₗ[ℚ] Fin n →₀ ℚ

declarations.name: PureU1.BasisLinear.asBasis
declarations.doc: The basis of `LinSols`.
declarations.statement: def asBasis : Basis (Fin n) ℚ ((PureU1 n.succ).LinSols)

declarations.doc: The module over `ℚ` defined by linear solutions to the pure `U(1)` ACCs is finite.
declarations.statement: instance : Module.Finite ℚ ((PureU1 n.succ).LinSols)

declarations.name: PureU1.BasisLinear.finrank_AnomalyFreeLinear
declarations.doc: The module of solutions to the linear pure-U(1) acc has rank equal to `n`.
declarations.statement:
lemma finrank_AnomalyFreeLinear :
    Module.finrank ℚ (((PureU1 n.succ).LinSols)) = n

modules.title: Charges assignments with constant abs
modules.doc: We look at charge assignments in which all charges have the same absolute value.

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsProp
declarations.doc: The condition for two rationals to have the same square (equivalent to same abs).
declarations.statement: def ConstAbsProp : ℚ × ℚ → Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbs
declarations.doc: The condition on a charge assignment `S` to have constant absolute value among charges.
declarations.statement: def ConstAbs (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.constAbs_perm
declarations.statement:
lemma constAbs_perm (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) (M :(FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ConstAbs ((FamilyPermutations n).rep M S) ↔ ConstAbs S

declarations.name: PureU1.constAbs_sort
declarations.statement: lemma constAbs_sort {S : (PureU1 n).Charges} (CA : ConstAbs S) : ConstAbs (sort S)

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted
declarations.doc: The condition for a set of charges to be `sorted`, and have `constAbs`
declarations.statement: def ConstAbsSorted (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.lt_eq
declarations.statement: lemma lt_eq {k i : Fin n.succ} (hk : S k ≤ 0) (hik : i ≤ k) : S i = S k

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.val_le_zero
declarations.statement: lemma val_le_zero {i : Fin n.succ} (hi : S i ≤ 0) : S i = S (0 : Fin n.succ)

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.gt_eq
declarations.statement: lemma gt_eq {k i: Fin n.succ} (hk : 0 ≤ S k) (hik : k ≤ i) : S i = S k

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.zero_gt
declarations.statement: lemma zero_gt (h0 : 0 ≤ S (0 : Fin n.succ)) (i : Fin n.succ) : S (0 : Fin n.succ) = S i

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.opposite_signs_eq_neg
declarations.statement: lemma opposite_signs_eq_neg {i j : Fin n.succ} (hi : S i ≤ 0) (hj : 0 ≤ S j) : S i = - S j

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.is_zero
declarations.statement: lemma is_zero (h0 : S (0 : Fin n.succ) = 0) : S = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.Boundary
declarations.doc:
A boundary of `S : (PureU1 n.succ).charges` (assumed sorted, constAbs and non-zero)
is defined as a element of `k ∈ Fin n` such that `S k.castSucc` and `S k.succ` are different signs.
declarations.statement: def Boundary (S : (PureU1 n.succ).Charges) (k : Fin n) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.boundary_castSucc
declarations.statement: lemma boundary_castSucc {k : Fin n} (hk : Boundary S k) : S k.castSucc = S (0 : Fin n.succ)

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.boundary_succ
declarations.statement: lemma boundary_succ {k : Fin n} (hk : Boundary S k) : S k.succ = - S (0 : Fin n.succ)

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.boundary_split
declarations.statement: lemma boundary_split (k : Fin n) : k.succ.val + (n.succ - k.succ.val) = n.succ

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.boundary_accGrav'
declarations.statement:
lemma boundary_accGrav' (k : Fin n) : accGrav n.succ S =
    ∑ i : Fin (k.succ.val + (n.succ - k.succ.val)), S (Fin.cast (boundary_split k) i)

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.boundary_accGrav''
declarations.statement:
lemma boundary_accGrav'' (k : Fin n) (hk : Boundary S k) :
    accGrav n.succ S = (2 * ↑↑k + 1 - ↑n) * S (0 : Fin n.succ)

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.HasBoundary
declarations.doc: A `S ∈ charges` has a boundary if there exists a `k ∈ Fin n` which is a boundary.
declarations.statement: def HasBoundary (S : (PureU1 n.succ).Charges) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.not_hasBoundary_zero_le
declarations.statement:
lemma not_hasBoundary_zero_le (hnot : ¬ (HasBoundary S)) (h0 : S (0 : Fin n.succ) < 0) :
    ∀ i, S (0 : Fin n.succ) = S i

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.not_hasBoundry_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma not_hasBoundry_zero (hnot : ¬ (HasBoundary S)) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    S (0 : Fin n.succ) = S i

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.not_hasBoundary_grav
declarations.statement:
lemma not_hasBoundary_grav (hnot : ¬ (HasBoundary S)) :
    accGrav n.succ S = n.succ * S (0 : Fin n.succ)

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.AFL_hasBoundary
declarations.statement: lemma AFL_hasBoundary (h : A.val (0 : Fin n.succ) ≠ 0) : HasBoundary A.val

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.AFL_odd_noBoundary
declarations.statement:
lemma AFL_odd_noBoundary {A : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : ConstAbsSorted A.val)
    (hA : A.val (0 : Fin (2*n +1)) ≠ 0) : ¬ HasBoundary A.val

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.AFL_odd_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma AFL_odd_zero {A : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : ConstAbsSorted A.val) :
    A.val (0 : Fin (2 * n + 1)) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.AFL_odd
declarations.statement:
lemma AFL_odd (A : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) (h : ConstAbsSorted A.val) :
    A = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.AFL_even_Boundary
declarations.statement:
lemma AFL_even_Boundary {A : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols} (h : ConstAbsSorted A.val)
    (hA : A.val (0 : Fin (2 * n.succ)) ≠ 0) {k : Fin (2 * n + 1)} (hk : Boundary A.val k) :
    k.val = n

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.AFL_even_below'
declarations.statement:
lemma AFL_even_below' {A : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols} (h : ConstAbsSorted A.val)
    (hA : A.val (0 : Fin (2 * n.succ)) ≠ 0) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    A.val (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ i)) = A.val (0 : Fin (2*n.succ))

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.AFL_even_below
declarations.statement:
lemma AFL_even_below (A : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols) (h : ConstAbsSorted A.val)
    (i : Fin n.succ) :
    A.val (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ i))

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.AFL_even_above'
declarations.statement:
lemma AFL_even_above' {A : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols} (h : ConstAbsSorted A.val)
    (hA : A.val (0 : Fin (2*n.succ)) ≠ 0) (i : Fin n.succ) :

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbsSorted.AFL_even_above
declarations.statement:
lemma AFL_even_above (A : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols) (h : ConstAbsSorted A.val)
    (i : Fin n.succ) :
    A.val (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ i)) =
    - A.val (0 : Fin (2 * n.succ))

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbs.boundary_value_odd
declarations.statement:
lemma boundary_value_odd (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) (hs : ConstAbs S.val) :

declarations.name: PureU1.ConstAbs.boundary_value_even
declarations.statement:
lemma boundary_value_even (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols) (hs : ConstAbs S.val) :

modules.title: Splitting the linear solutions in the even case into two ACC-satisfying planes
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

We split the linear solutions of `PureU1 (2 * n.succ)` into two planes,
where every point in either plane satisfies both the linear and cubic anomaly cancellation
conditions.

## ii. Key results

- `Unshifted.planeLinSols` : The inclusion of the unshifted plane into linear solutions
- `Unshifted.planeCharges_accCube` : The statement that charges from the unshifted plane
  satisfy the cubic ACC
- `Shifted.planeLinSols` : The inclusion of the shifted plane.
- `Shifted.planeCharges_accCube` : The statement that charges from the shifted plane
  satisfy the cubic ACC
- `span_basis` : Every linear solution is the sum of a point from each plane.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Splitting the charges up into groups
  - A.1. The even split: Spltting the charges up via `n.succ + n.succ`
  - A.2. The shifted even split: Spltting the charges up via `1 + (n + n + 1)`
  - A.3. Lemmas relating the two splittings
- B. The unshifted plane

  - B.4. The basis vectors satisfy the cubic ACC

  - B.10. The inclusion of the plane into linear solutions
  - B.11. The basis vectors are linearly independent
  - B.12. Every vector-like even solution is in the span of the basis of the unshifted plane
- C. The shifted plane
  - C.2. Components of the vectors

  - C.4. The vectors satisfy the cubic ACC

- D. Mixed cubic ACCs involving points from both planes
- E. The combined basis
  - E.1. As a map into linear solutions
  - E.2. Inclusion of the span of the basis into charges

## A. Splitting the charges up into groups

We have `2 * n.succ` charges, which we split up in the following ways:

`| evenFst j (0 to n) | evenSnd j (n.succ to n + n.succ)|`

```
| evenShiftZero (0) | evenShiftFst j (1 to n) |
  evenShiftSnd j (n.succ to 2 * n) | evenShiftLast (2 * n.succ - 1) |
```

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.evenFst
declarations.doc:
The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`.
declarations.statement: def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.evenSnd
declarations.doc:
The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`.
declarations.statement: def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.ext_even
declarations.statement:
lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.sum_even
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.n_cond₂
declarations.statement: lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.evenShiftFst
declarations.doc:
The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`.
declarations.statement: def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.evenShiftSnd
declarations.doc:
The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`.
declarations.statement: def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.evenShiftZero
declarations.doc:
The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`.
declarations.statement: def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.evenShiftLast
declarations.doc:
The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`.
declarations.statement: def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.sum_evenShift
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero
declarations.statement: lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last
declarations.statement: lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ
declarations.statement: lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc
declarations.statement: lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.basisAsCharges
declarations.doc: The unshifted part of the basis as charges.
declarations.statement: def basisAsCharges (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.basis_on_evenFst_self
declarations.statement: lemma basis_on_evenFst_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenFst j) = 1

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.basis_on_evenFst_other
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_on_evenFst_other {k j : Fin n.succ} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basisAsCharges k (evenFst j) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.basis_on_other
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_on_other {k : Fin n.succ} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenSnd k) : basisAsCharges k j = 0

declarations.statement:
lemma basis_evenSnd_eq_neg_evenFst (j i : Fin n.succ) :
    basisAsCharges j (evenSnd i) = - basisAsCharges j (evenFst i)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.basis_on_evenSnd_self
declarations.statement: lemma basis_on_evenSnd_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenSnd j) = - 1

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.basis_on_evenSnd_other
declarations.statement: lemma basis_on_evenSnd_other {k j : Fin n.succ} (h : k ≠ j) : basisAsCharges k (evenSnd j) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.basis_linearACC
declarations.statement: lemma basis_linearACC (j : Fin n.succ) : (accGrav (2 * n.succ)) (basisAsCharges j) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.basis_accCube
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_accCube (j : Fin n.succ) :
    accCube (2 * n.succ) (basisAsCharges j) = 0

declarations.doc: The unshifted part of the basis as `LinSols`.
declarations.statement: def basis (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.planeCharges
declarations.doc: A point in the span of the unshifted part of the basis as a charge.
declarations.statement: def planeCharges (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.planeCharges_evenFst
declarations.statement:
lemma planeCharges_evenFst (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (j : Fin n.succ) :
    planeCharges f (evenFst j) = f j

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.planeCharges_evenSnd
declarations.statement:
lemma planeCharges_evenSnd (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (j : Fin n.succ) :
    planeCharges f (evenSnd j) = - f j

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.planeCharges_evenSnd_evenFst
declarations.statement:
lemma planeCharges_evenSnd_evenFst (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) :
    planeCharges f ∘ evenSnd = - planeCharges f ∘ evenFst

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.planeCharges_linearACC
declarations.statement:
lemma planeCharges_linearACC (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) :
    (accGrav (2 * n.succ)) (planeCharges f) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.planeCharges_accCube
declarations.statement: lemma planeCharges_accCube (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) : accCube (2 * n.succ) (planeCharges f) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.planeCharges_zero
declarations.statement: lemma planeCharges_zero (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (h : planeCharges f = 0) : ∀ i, f i = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.planeLinSols
declarations.doc: A point in the span of the unshifted part of the basis.
declarations.statement: def planeLinSols (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.planeLinSols_val
declarations.statement: lemma planeLinSols_val (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) : (planeLinSols f).val = planeCharges f

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.basis_linear_independent

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Unshifted.vectorLikeEven_in_span
declarations.statement:
lemma vectorLikeEven_in_span (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols)
    (hS : VectorLikeEven S.val) : ∃ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ)).group),
      (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ)).linSolRep M S ∈ Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range basis)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.basisAsCharges

declarations.statement: def basisAsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.basis_on_evenShiftFst_self
declarations.statement: lemma basis_on_evenShiftFst_self (j : Fin n) : basisAsCharges j (evenShiftFst j) = 1

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.basis_on_evenShiftFst_other

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.basis_on_evenShiftSnd_other
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_on_evenShiftSnd_other {k j : Fin n} (h : k ≠ j) :

declarations.statement: lemma basis_on_evenShiftZero (j : Fin n) : basisAsCharges j evenShiftZero = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.basis_on_evenShiftLast

    accCube (2 * n.succ) (basisAsCharges j) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.basis
declarations.doc: The shifted part of the basis as `LinSols`.
declarations.statement: def basis (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.planeCharges
declarations.doc: A point in the span of the shifted part of the basis as a charge.
declarations.statement: def planeCharges (f : Fin n → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.planeCharges_evenShiftFst
declarations.statement:
lemma planeCharges_evenShiftFst (f : Fin n → ℚ) (j : Fin n) :
    planeCharges f (evenShiftFst j) = f j

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.planeCharges_evenShiftSnd
declarations.statement:
lemma planeCharges_evenShiftSnd (f : Fin n → ℚ) (j : Fin n) :
    planeCharges f (evenShiftSnd j) = - f j

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.planeCharges_evenShiftZero
declarations.statement: lemma planeCharges_evenShiftZero (f : Fin n → ℚ) : planeCharges f (evenShiftZero) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.planeCharges_evenShiftLast
declarations.statement: lemma planeCharges_evenShiftLast (f : Fin n → ℚ) : planeCharges f evenShiftLast = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.planeCharges_accCube
declarations.statement: lemma planeCharges_accCube (f : Fin n → ℚ) : accCube (2 * n.succ) (planeCharges f) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.planeCharges_zero
declarations.statement: lemma planeCharges_zero (f : Fin n → ℚ) (h : planeCharges f = 0) : ∀ i, f i = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.planeCharges_in_span
declarations.statement:
lemma planeCharges_in_span (f : Fin n → ℚ) :
    planeCharges f ∈ Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range basisAsCharges)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.planeLinSols
declarations.doc: A point in the span of the shifted part of the basis.
declarations.statement: def planeLinSols (f : Fin n → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.planeLinSols_val
declarations.statement: lemma planeLinSols_val (f : Fin n → ℚ) : (planeLinSols f).val = planeCharges f

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.basis_linear_independent
declarations.statement: lemma basis_linear_independent : LinearIndependent ℚ (@basis n)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.smul_basisAsCharges_in_span
declarations.statement:
lemma smul_basisAsCharges_in_span (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols) (j : Fin n) :
    (S.val (evenShiftSnd j) - S.val (evenShiftFst j)) • basisAsCharges j ∈
    Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range basisAsCharges)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Shifted.swap_as_add
declarations.doc:
Swapping the elements evenShiftFst j and evenShiftSnd j is equivalent to
adding a vector basisAsCharges j.
declarations.statement:
lemma swap_as_add {S S' : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols} (j : Fin n)
    (hS : ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ)).linSolRep
    (Equiv.swap (evenShiftFst j) (evenShiftSnd j))) S = S') :
    S'.val = S.val + (S.val (evenShiftSnd j) - S.val (evenShiftFst j)) • basisAsCharges j

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.unshifted_unshifted_shifted_accCube
declarations.statement:
lemma unshifted_unshifted_shifted_accCube (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (j : Fin n) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
      (Shifted.basisAsCharges j)
    = g (j.succ) ^ 2 - g (j.castSucc) ^ 2

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.shifted_shifted_unshifted_accCube
declarations.statement:
lemma shifted_shifted_unshifted_accCube (g : Fin n → ℚ) (j : Fin n.succ) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (Shifted.planeCharges g) (Shifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.basisAsCharges j)
    = (Shifted.planeCharges g (evenFst j))^2 - (Shifted.planeCharges g (evenSnd j))^2

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.basisa
declarations.doc: The whole basis as `LinSols`.
declarations.statement: def basisa : (Fin n.succ) ⊕ (Fin n) → (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Pa
declarations.doc: A point in the span of the basis as a charge.
declarations.statement: def Pa (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (g : Fin n → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Pa_evenShiftFst
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa_evenShiftFst (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (g : Fin n → ℚ) (j : Fin n) :
    Pa f g (evenShiftFst j) = f j.succ + g j

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Pa_evenShiftSnd
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa_evenShiftSnd (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (g : Fin n → ℚ) (j : Fin n) :
    Pa f g (evenShiftSnd j) = - f j.castSucc - g j

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Pa_evenShitZero
declarations.statement: lemma Pa_evenShitZero (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (g : Fin n → ℚ) : Pa f g (evenShiftZero) = f 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Pa_evenShiftLast
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa_evenShiftLast (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (g : Fin n → ℚ) :
    Pa f g (evenShiftLast) = - f (Fin.last n)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Pa_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa_zero (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (g : Fin n → ℚ) (h : Pa f g = 0) :
    ∀ i, f i = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Pa_zero!
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa_zero! (f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (g : Fin n → ℚ) (h : Pa f g = 0) :
    ∀ i, g i = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Pa'
declarations.doc: A point in the span of the whole basis.
declarations.statement: def Pa' (f : (Fin n.succ) ⊕ (Fin n) → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Pa'_P'_P!'
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa'_P'_P!' (f : (Fin n.succ) ⊕ (Fin n) → ℚ) :
    Pa' f = Unshifted.planeLinSols (f ∘ Sum.inl) + Shifted.planeLinSols (f ∘ Sum.inr)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.basisa_linear_independent
declarations.statement: lemma basisa_linear_independent : LinearIndependent ℚ (@basisa n)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Pa'_eq
declarations.statement: lemma Pa'_eq (f f' : (Fin n.succ) ⊕ (Fin n) → ℚ) : Pa' f = Pa' f' ↔ f = f'

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Pa'_elim_eq_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa'_elim_eq_iff (g g' : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f f' : Fin n → ℚ) :
    Pa' (Sum.elim g f) = Pa' (Sum.elim g' f') ↔ Pa g f = Pa g' f'

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.Pa_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa_eq (g g' : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f f' : Fin n → ℚ) :
    Pa g f = Pa g' f' ↔ g = g' ∧ f = f'

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.basisa_card
declarations.statement:
lemma basisa_card : Fintype.card ((Fin n.succ) ⊕ (Fin n)) =
    Module.finrank ℚ (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.basisaAsBasis
declarations.doc: The basis formed out of our `basisa` vectors.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def basisaAsBasis :
    Basis (Fin (succ n) ⊕ Fin n) ℚ (PureU1 (2 * succ n)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.span_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma span_basis (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols) :
    ∃ (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ),
      S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.span_basis_swap!
declarations.statement:
lemma span_basis_swap! {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols} (j : Fin n)
    (hS : ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ)).linSolRep
    (Equiv.swap (evenShiftFst j) (evenShiftSnd j))) S = S') (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ)
    (h : S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f) :
    ∃ (g' : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f' : Fin n → ℚ),
      S'.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g' + Shifted.planeCharges f' ∧
      Shifted.planeCharges f' = Shifted.planeCharges f +
      (S.val (evenShiftSnd j) - S.val (evenShiftFst j)) • Shifted.basisAsCharges j ∧ g' = g

modules.title: Line In Cubic Even case
modules.doc:
We say that a linear solution satisfies the `lineInCubic` property
if the line through that point and through the two different planes formed by the basis of
`LinSols` lies in the cubic.

We show that for a solution all its permutations satisfy this property, then there exists
a permutation for which it lies in the unshifted plane.

## References

* The main reference for this file is https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf. [ref: arxiv_1912_04804]

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.LineInCubic
declarations.doc:
A property on `LinSols`, satisfied if every point on the line between the two planes
in the basis through that point is in the cubic.
declarations.statement: def LineInCubic (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.lineInCubic_expand
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f) (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b *
      (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
          (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Shifted.planeCharges f) +
        b * accCubeTriLinSymm (Shifted.planeCharges f)
          (Shifted.planeCharges f) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.line_in_cubic_unshifted_unshifted_shifted
declarations.doc:
This lemma states that for a given `S` of type `(PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).AnomalyFreeLinear` and
a proof `h` that the line through `S` lies on a cubic curve,
for any functions `g : Fin n.succ → ℚ` and `f : Fin n → ℚ`, if
`S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f`,
then
`accCubeTriLinSymm.toFun (Unshifted.planeCharges g, Unshifted.planeCharges g,
  Shifted.planeCharges f) = 0`.
declarations.statement:
lemma line_in_cubic_unshifted_unshifted_shifted
    {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ)
      (_ : S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f),
    accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
      (Shifted.planeCharges f) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.LineInCubicPerm
declarations.doc: A `LinSol` satisfies `LineInCubicPerm` if all its permutations satisfy `lineInCubic`.
declarations.statement: def LineInCubicPerm (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.lineInCubicPerm_self
declarations.doc: If `lineInCubicPerm S` then `lineInCubic S`.
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubicPerm_self {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols}
    (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) : LineInCubic S

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.lineInCubicPerm_permute
declarations.doc: If `lineInCubicPerm S` then `lineInCubicPerm (M S)` for all permutations `M`.

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.lineInCubicPerm_swap
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubicPerm_swap {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    ∀ (j : Fin n) (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f),
      (S.val (evenShiftSnd j) - S.val (evenShiftFst j))
      * accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
        (Shifted.basisAsCharges j) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.unshifted_unshifted_shifted_accCube'
declarations.statement:
lemma unshifted_unshifted_shifted_accCube' {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ)).LinSols}
    (f : Fin n.succ.succ → ℚ) (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (hS : S.val = Pa f g) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges f) (Unshifted.planeCharges f)
      (Shifted.basisAsCharges (Fin.last n)) =
    - (S.val (evenShiftSnd (Fin.last n)) + S.val (evenShiftFst (Fin.last n))) *
    (2 * S.val evenShiftLast +
    S.val (evenShiftSnd (Fin.last n)) + S.val (evenShiftFst (Fin.last n)))

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.lineInCubicPerm_last_cond
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubicPerm_last_cond {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInPlaneProp
    ((S.val (evenShiftSnd (Fin.last n))), ((S.val (evenShiftFst (Fin.last n))),
      (S.val evenShiftLast)))

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.lineInCubicPerm_last_perm
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubicPerm_last_perm {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) : LineInPlaneCond S

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.lineInCubicPerm_constAbs
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubicPerm_constAbs {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ)).Sols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S.1.1) : ConstAbs S.val

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.lineInCubicPerm_vectorLike
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubicPerm_vectorLike {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ)).Sols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S.1.1) : VectorLikeEven S.val

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.lineInCubicPerm_in_plane
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubicPerm_in_plane (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ)).Sols)
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S.1.1) : ∃ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ.succ)).group),
    (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ.succ)).linSolRep M S.1.1
    ∈ Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range Unshifted.basis)

modules.title: Parameterization in even case
modules.doc:
Given maps `g : Fin n.succ → ℚ`, `f : Fin n → ℚ` and `a : ℚ` we form a solution to the anomaly
equations. We show that every solution can be got in this way, up to permutation, unless it, up to
permutation, lives in the unshifted plane.

## References

* The main reference is https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf. [ref: arxiv_1912_04804]

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.parameterizationAsLinear
declarations.doc:
Given coefficients `g` of a point in the unshifted plane and `f` of a point in the
shifted plane, and a rational, we get a
rational `a ∈ ℚ`, we get a
point in `(PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).AnomalyFreeLinear`, which we will later show extends to an anomaly
free point.
declarations.statement:
def parameterizationAsLinear (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (a : ℚ) :
    (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.parameterizationAsLinear_val
declarations.statement:
lemma parameterizationAsLinear_val (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (a : ℚ) :
    (parameterizationAsLinear g f a).val =
    a •
      ((accCubeTriLinSymm (Shifted.planeCharges f) (Shifted.planeCharges f)
          (Unshifted.planeCharges g)) • Unshifted.planeCharges g +
        (- accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
          (Shifted.planeCharges f)) • Shifted.planeCharges f)

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.parameterizationCharge_cube
declarations.statement:
lemma parameterizationCharge_cube (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (a : ℚ) :
    accCube (2* n.succ) (parameterizationAsLinear g f a).val = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.parameterization
declarations.doc: The construction of a `Sol` from a `Fin n.succ → ℚ`, a `Fin n → ℚ` and a `ℚ`.
declarations.statement:
def parameterization (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (a : ℚ) :
    (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Sols

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.anomalyFree_param
declarations.statement:
lemma anomalyFree_param {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Sols}
    (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ)
    (hS : S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
      (Shifted.planeCharges f) =
      - accCubeTriLinSymm (Shifted.planeCharges f) (Shifted.planeCharges f)
        (Unshifted.planeCharges g)

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.GenericCase
declarations.doc:
A proposition on a solution which is true if
`accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g, Unshifted.planeCharges g,
  Shifted.planeCharges f) ≠ 0`.
In this case our parameterization above will be able to recover this point.
declarations.statement: def GenericCase (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Sols) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.genericCase_exists
declarations.statement:
lemma genericCase_exists (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Sols)
    (hs : ∃ (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ),
      S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f ∧
      accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
        (Shifted.planeCharges f) ≠ 0) : GenericCase S

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.SpecialCase
declarations.doc:
A proposition on a solution which is true if
`accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g, Unshifted.planeCharges g,
  Shifted.planeCharges f) = 0`.
declarations.statement: def SpecialCase (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Sols) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.specialCase_exists
declarations.statement:
lemma specialCase_exists (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Sols)
    (hs : ∃ (g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ),
      S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f ∧
      accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
        (Shifted.planeCharges f) = 0) : SpecialCase S

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.generic_or_special
declarations.statement:
lemma generic_or_special (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Sols) :
    GenericCase S ∨ SpecialCase S

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.generic_case
declarations.statement:
lemma generic_case {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Sols} (h : GenericCase S) :
    ∃ g f a, S = parameterization g f a

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.special_case_lineInCubic
declarations.statement:
lemma special_case_lineInCubic {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Sols}
    (h : SpecialCase S) : LineInCubic S.1.1

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.special_case_lineInCubic_perm
declarations.statement:
lemma special_case_lineInCubic_perm {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Sols}
    (h : ∀ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ)).group),
    SpecialCase ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ)).solAction.toFun _ _ S M)) :
    LineInCubicPerm S.1.1

declarations.name: PureU1.Even.special_case
declarations.statement:
lemma special_case {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ)).Sols}
    (h : ∀ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ.succ)).group),
    SpecialCase ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ.succ)).solAction.toFun _ _ S M)) :
    ∃ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ.succ)).group),
    ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ.succ)).solAction.toFun _ _ S M).1.1
    ∈ Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range Unshifted.basis)

modules.title: Line in plane condition
modules.doc:
We say a `LinSol` satisfies the `line in plane` condition if for all distinct `i1`, `i2`, `i3` in
`Fin n`, we have
`S i1 = S i2` or `S i1 = - S i2` or `2 S i3 + S i1 + S i2 = 0`.

We look at various consequences of this.
The main reference for this material is

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf [ref: arxiv_1912_04804]

We will show that `n ≥ 4` the `line in plane` condition on solutions implies the
`constAbs` condition.

declarations.name: PureU1.LineInPlaneProp
declarations.doc: The proposition on three rationals to satisfy the `linInPlane` condition.
declarations.statement: def LineInPlaneProp : ℚ × ℚ × ℚ → Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.LineInPlaneCond
declarations.doc: The proposition on a `LinSol` to satisfy the `linInPlane` condition.
declarations.statement: def LineInPlaneCond (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.lineInPlaneCond_perm
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInPlaneCond_perm {S : (PureU1 n).LinSols} (hS : LineInPlaneCond S)
    (M : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    LineInPlaneCond ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep M S)

declarations.name: PureU1.lineInPlaneCond_eq_last'
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInPlaneCond_eq_last' {S : (PureU1 (n.succ.succ)).LinSols} (hS : LineInPlaneCond S)
    (h : ¬ (S.val ((Fin.last n).castSucc))^2 = (S.val ((Fin.last n).succ))^2) :
    (2 - n) * S.val (Fin.last (n + 1)) =
    - (2 - n)* S.val (Fin.castSucc (Fin.last n))

declarations.name: PureU1.lineInPlaneCond_eq_last
PureU1.linesInPlane_eq_sq
PureU1.linesInPlane_constAbs
declarations.statement:
lemma linesInPlane_constAbs {S : (PureU1 (n.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ)).LinSols}
    (hS : LineInPlaneCond S) : ConstAbs S.val

declarations.name: PureU1.linesInPlane_four
declarations.statement:
lemma linesInPlane_four (S : (PureU1 4).Sols) (hS : LineInPlaneCond S.1.1) :

modules.title: Splitting the linear solutions in the odd case into two ACC-satisfying planes
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

We split the linear solutions of `PureU1 (2 * n + 1)` into two planes,
where every point in either plane satisfies both the linear and cubic anomaly cancellation
conditions.

## ii. Key results

- `Unshifted.planeLinSols` : The inclusion of the unshifted plane into linear solutions
- `Unshifted.planeCharges_accCube` : The statement that charges from the unshifted plane
  satisfy the cubic ACC
- `Shifted.planeLinSols` : The inclusion of the shifted plane.
- `Shifted.planeCharges_accCube` : The statement that charges from the shifted plane
  satisfy the cubic ACC
- `span_basis` : Every linear solution is the sum of a point from each plane.

## iii. Table of contents

We have `2 * n + 1` charges, which we split up in the following ways:

lemma swap_as_add {S S' : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (j : Fin n)

declarations.statement:
lemma P_P_P!_accCube (g : Fin n → ℚ) (j : Fin n) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
      (Shifted.basisAsCharges j)
    = (Unshifted.planeCharges g (oddShiftFst j))^2 - (g j)^2

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.basisa
declarations.doc: The whole Unshifted.basis as `LinSols`.
declarations.statement: def basisa : Fin n ⊕ Fin n → (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.Pa
declarations.doc: A point in the span of the Unshifted.basis as a charge.
declarations.statement: def Pa (f : Fin n → ℚ) (g : Fin n → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).Charges

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.Pa_oddShiftShiftZero
declarations.statement: lemma Pa_oddShiftShiftZero (f g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) : Pa f g oddShiftShiftZero = f 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.Pa_oddShiftShiftFst
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa_oddShiftShiftFst (f g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (j : Fin n) :
    Pa f g (oddShiftShiftFst j) = f j.succ + g j.castSucc

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.Pa_oddShiftShiftMid
declarations.statement: lemma Pa_oddShiftShiftMid (f g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) : Pa f g oddShiftShiftMid = g (Fin.last n)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.Pa_oddShiftShiftSnd
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa_oddShiftShiftSnd (f g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (j : Fin n.succ) :
    Pa f g (oddShiftShiftSnd j) = - f j - g j

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.Pa_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa_zero (f g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (h : Pa f g = 0) :
    ∀ i, f i = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.Pa_zero!
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa_zero! (f g : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (h : Pa f g = 0) :
    ∀ i, g i = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.Pa'
declarations.doc: A point in the span of the whole Unshifted.basis.
declarations.statement: def Pa' (f : (Fin n) ⊕ (Fin n) → ℚ) : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.Pa'_P'_P!'
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa'_P'_P!' (f : (Fin n) ⊕ (Fin n) → ℚ) :
    Pa' f = Unshifted.planeLinSols (f ∘ Sum.inl) + Shifted.planeLinSols (f ∘ Sum.inr)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.basisa_linear_independent
declarations.statement: lemma basisa_linear_independent : LinearIndependent ℚ (@basisa n.succ)

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.Pa'_eq
declarations.statement: lemma Pa'_eq (f f' : (Fin n.succ) ⊕ (Fin n.succ) → ℚ) : Pa' f = Pa' f' ↔ f = f'

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.Pa'_elim_eq_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa'_elim_eq_iff (g g' : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f f' : Fin n.succ → ℚ) :
    Pa' (Sum.elim g f) = Pa' (Sum.elim g' f') ↔ Pa g f = Pa g' f'

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.Pa_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma Pa_eq (g g' : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (f f' : Fin n.succ → ℚ) :
    Pa g f = Pa g' f' ↔ g = g' ∧ f = f'

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.basisa_card
declarations.statement:
lemma basisa_card : Fintype.card ((Fin n.succ) ⊕ (Fin n.succ)) =
    Module.finrank ℚ (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.basisaAsBasis
declarations.doc: The Unshifted.basis formed out of our basisa vectors.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def basisaAsBasis :
    Basis (Fin n.succ ⊕ Fin n.succ) ℚ (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.span_basis
declarations.statement:
lemma span_basis (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols) :
    ∃ (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ), S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.span_basis_swap!
declarations.statement:
lemma span_basis_swap! {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols} (j : Fin n.succ)
    (hS : ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (Equiv.swap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j))) S = S') (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ)
    (hS1 : S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f) : ∃ (g' f' : Fin n.succ → ℚ),
    S'.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g' + Shifted.planeCharges f' ∧
    Shifted.planeCharges f' = Shifted.planeCharges f +
    (S.val (oddShiftSnd j) - S.val (oddShiftFst j)) • Shifted.basisAsCharges j ∧ g' = g

modules.title: Line In Cubic Odd case
modules.doc:
We say that a linear solution satisfies the `lineInCubic` property
if the line through that point and through the two different planes formed by the basis of
`LinSols` lies in the cubic.

We show that for a solution all its permutations satisfy this property,
then the charge must be zero.

## References

* The main reference for this file is https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf. [ref: arxiv_1912_04804]

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.LineInCubic
declarations.doc:
A property on `LinSols`, satisfied if every point on the line between the two planes
in the basis through that point is in the cubic.
declarations.statement: def LineInCubic (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.lineInCubic_expand
declarations.doc:
The condition that a linear solution sits on a line between the two planes
within the cubic expands into a on `accCubeTriLinSymm` applied to the points
within the planes.
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ)
      (_ : S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f)
      (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b *
      (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
          (Shifted.planeCharges f) +
        b * accCubeTriLinSymm (Shifted.planeCharges f) (Shifted.planeCharges f)
          (Unshifted.planeCharges g)) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.line_in_cubic_P_P_P!
declarations.statement:
lemma line_in_cubic_P_P_P! {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ)
      (_ : S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f),
    accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
      (Shifted.planeCharges f) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.LineInCubicPerm
declarations.doc: A `LinSol` satisfies `lineInCubicPerm` if all its permutations satisfy `lineInCubic`.
declarations.statement: def LineInCubicPerm (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.lineInCubicPerm_self
declarations.doc: If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubic S`.
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubicPerm_self {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInCubic S

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.lineInCubicPerm_permute
declarations.doc: If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubicPerm (M S)` for all permutations `M`.

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.lineInCubicPerm_swap
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubicPerm_swap {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    ∀ (j : Fin n.succ) (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f),
      (S.val (oddShiftSnd j) - S.val (oddShiftFst j))
      * accCubeTriLinSymm
        (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
        (Shifted.basisAsCharges j) = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.P_P_P!_accCube'
declarations.statement:
lemma P_P_P!_accCube' {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (f g : Fin n.succ.succ → ℚ) (hS : S.val = Pa f g) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges f) (Unshifted.planeCharges f)
      (Shifted.basisAsCharges 0) =
    (S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) *
    (2 * S.val oddShiftZero + S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0))

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.lineInCubicPerm_last_cond
PureU1.Odd.lineInCubicPerm_last_perm
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubicPerm_last_perm {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) : LineInPlaneCond S

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.lineInCubicPerm_constAbs
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubicPerm_constAbs {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) : ConstAbs S.val

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.lineInCubicPerm_zero
declarations.statement:
lemma lineInCubicPerm_zero {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) : S = 0

modules.title: Parameterization in odd case
modules.doc:
Given maps `g : Fin n → ℚ`, `f : Fin n → ℚ` and `a : ℚ` we form a solution to the anomaly
equations. We show that every solution can be got in this way, up to permutation, unless it is zero.

## References

* The main reference is https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf. [ref: arxiv_1912_04804]

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.parameterizationAsLinear
declarations.doc:
Given a `g f : Fin n → ℚ` and a `a : ℚ` we form a linear solution. We will later
show that this can be extended to a complete solution.
declarations.statement:
def parameterizationAsLinear (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (a : ℚ) :
    (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.parameterizationAsLinear_val
declarations.statement:
lemma parameterizationAsLinear_val (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (a : ℚ) :
    (parameterizationAsLinear g f a).val =
    a •
      ((accCubeTriLinSymm (Shifted.planeCharges f) (Shifted.planeCharges f)
          (Unshifted.planeCharges g)) • Unshifted.planeCharges g +
        (- accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
          (Shifted.planeCharges f)) • Shifted.planeCharges f)

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.parameterizationCharge_cube
declarations.doc: The parameterization satisfies the cubic ACC.
declarations.statement:
lemma parameterizationCharge_cube (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (a : ℚ) :
    accCube (2 * n + 1) (parameterizationAsLinear g f a).val = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.parameterization
declarations.doc: Given a `g f : Fin n → ℚ` and a `a : ℚ` we form a solution.
declarations.statement:
def parameterization (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (a : ℚ) :
    (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).Sols

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.anomalyFree_param
declarations.statement:
lemma anomalyFree_param {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).Sols}
    (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (hS : S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
      (Shifted.planeCharges f) =
    - accCubeTriLinSymm (Shifted.planeCharges f) (Shifted.planeCharges f)
      (Unshifted.planeCharges g)

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.GenericCase
declarations.doc:
A proposition on a solution which is true if
`accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g, Unshifted.planeCharges g,
Shifted.planeCharges f) ≠ 0`.
In this case our parameterization above will be able to recover this point.
declarations.statement: def GenericCase (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).Sols) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.genericCase_exists
declarations.statement:
lemma genericCase_exists (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).Sols)
    (hs : ∃ (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ),
      S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f ∧
      accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
        (Shifted.planeCharges f) ≠ 0) : GenericCase S

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.SpecialCase
declarations.doc:
A proposition on a solution which is true if
`accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g, Unshifted.planeCharges g,
Shifted.planeCharges f) ≠ 0`.
In this case we will show that S is zero if it is true for all permutations.
declarations.statement: def SpecialCase (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).Sols) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.specialCase_exists
declarations.statement:
lemma specialCase_exists (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).Sols)
    (hs : ∃ (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ),
      S.val = Unshifted.planeCharges g + Shifted.planeCharges f ∧
      accCubeTriLinSymm (Unshifted.planeCharges g) (Unshifted.planeCharges g)
        (Shifted.planeCharges f) = 0) : SpecialCase S

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.generic_or_special
declarations.statement:
lemma generic_or_special (S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).Sols) :
    GenericCase S ∨ SpecialCase S

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.generic_case
declarations.statement:
lemma generic_case {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).Sols} (h : GenericCase S) :
    ∃ g f a, S = parameterization g f a

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.special_case_lineInCubic
PureU1.Odd.special_case_lineInCubic_perm
declarations.statement:
lemma special_case_lineInCubic_perm {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).Sols}
    (h : ∀ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).group),
    SpecialCase ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).solAction.toFun _ _ S M)) :
    LineInCubicPerm S.1.1

declarations.name: PureU1.Odd.special_case
declarations.statement:
lemma special_case {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).Sols}
    (h : ∀ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).group),
    SpecialCase ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).solAction.toFun _ _ S M)) :
    S.1.1 = 0

modules.title: Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC
modules.doc:
We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

declarations.name: PureU1.PermGroup
declarations.doc: The permutation group of the n-fermions.
declarations.statement: def PermGroup (n : ℕ)

declarations.doc: The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`.
declarations.statement: instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n)

declarations.name: PureU1.chargeMap
declarations.doc: The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges.
declarations.statement:
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges

declarations.name: PureU1.permCharges
declarations.doc: The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges.
declarations.statement: def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges

declarations.name: PureU1.accGrav_invariant
declarations.statement:
lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S

declarations.name: PureU1.accCube_invariant
declarations.statement:
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S

declarations.name: PureU1.FamilyPermutations
declarations.doc: The permutations acting on the ACC system.
declarations.statement: def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n)

declarations.name: PureU1.FamilyPermutations_charges_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i)

declarations.name: PureU1.FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i)

declarations.name: PureU1.permOfInjection
declarations.doc: A permutation of fermions which takes one ordered subset into another.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def permOfInjection (f g : Fin m ↪ Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group

declarations.name: PureU1.permTwoInj
declarations.doc: Given two distinct elements, an embedding of `Fin 2` into `Fin n`.
declarations.statement: def permTwoInj : Fin 2 ↪ Fin n

declarations.name: PureU1.permTwoInj_fst
declarations.statement: lemma permTwoInj_fst : i ∈ Set.range ⇑(permTwoInj hij)

declarations.name: PureU1.permTwoInj_fst_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma permTwoInj_fst_apply :
    (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permTwoInj hij)).symm ⟨i, permTwoInj_fst hij⟩ = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.permTwoInj_snd
declarations.statement: lemma permTwoInj_snd : j ∈ Set.range ⇑(permTwoInj hij)

declarations.name: PureU1.permTwoInj_snd_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma permTwoInj_snd_apply :
    (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permTwoInj hij)).symm
    ⟨j, permTwoInj_snd hij⟩ = 1

declarations.name: PureU1.permTwo
declarations.doc: A permutation which swaps `i` with `i'` and `j` with `j'`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def permTwo : (FamilyPermutations n).group

declarations.name: PureU1.permTwo_fst
declarations.statement: lemma permTwo_fst : (permTwo hij hij').toFun i' = i

declarations.name: PureU1.permTwo_snd
declarations.statement: lemma permTwo_snd : (permTwo hij hij').toFun j' = j

declarations.name: PureU1.permThreeInj
declarations.doc: Given three distinct elements an embedding of `Fin 3` into `Fin n`.
declarations.statement: def permThreeInj : Fin 3 ↪ Fin n

declarations.name: PureU1.permThreeInj_fst
declarations.statement: lemma permThreeInj_fst : i ∈ Set.range ⇑(permThreeInj hij hjk hik)

declarations.name: PureU1.permThreeInj_fst_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma permThreeInj_fst_apply :
    (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permThreeInj hij hjk hik)).symm
    ⟨i, permThreeInj_fst hij hjk hik⟩ = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.permThreeInj_snd
declarations.statement: lemma permThreeInj_snd : j ∈ Set.range ⇑(permThreeInj hij hjk hik)

declarations.name: PureU1.permThreeInj_snd_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma permThreeInj_snd_apply :
    (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permThreeInj hij hjk hik)).symm
    ⟨j, permThreeInj_snd hij hjk hik⟩ = 1

declarations.name: PureU1.permThreeInj_thd
declarations.statement: lemma permThreeInj_thd : k ∈ Set.range ⇑(permThreeInj hij hjk hik)

declarations.name: PureU1.permThreeInj_thd_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma permThreeInj_thd_apply :
    (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permThreeInj hij hjk hik)).symm
    ⟨k, permThreeInj_thd hij hjk hik⟩ = 2

declarations.name: PureU1.permThree
declarations.doc: A permutation which swaps three distinct elements with another three.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def permThree : (FamilyPermutations n).group

declarations.name: PureU1.permThree_fst
declarations.statement: lemma permThree_fst : (permThree hij hjk hik hij' hjk' hik').toFun i' = i

declarations.name: PureU1.permThree_snd
declarations.statement: lemma permThree_snd : (permThree hij hjk hik hij' hjk' hik').toFun j' = j

declarations.name: PureU1.permThree_thd
declarations.statement: lemma permThree_thd : (permThree hij hjk hik hij' hjk' hik').toFun k' = k

declarations.name: PureU1.Prop_two
declarations.statement:
lemma Prop_two (P : ℚ × ℚ → Prop) {S : (PureU1 n).LinSols}
    {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (h : ∀ (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group),
    P ((((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val a),
      (((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val b))) : ∀ (i j : Fin n) (_ : i ≠ j),
    P (S.val i, S.val j)

declarations.name: PureU1.Prop_three
declarations.statement:
lemma Prop_three (P : ℚ × ℚ × ℚ → Prop) {S : (PureU1 n).LinSols}
    {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (h : ∀ (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group),
    P ((((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val a),
      ((((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val b),
      (((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val c)))) : ∀ (i j k : Fin n)
      (_ : i ≠ j) (_ : j ≠ k) (_ : i ≠ k), P (S.val i, (S.val j, S.val k))

modules.title: Sort for Pure U(1) charges
modules.doc: We define the sort function for Pure U(1) charges, and prove some basic properties.

declarations.name: PureU1.Sorted
declarations.doc: A charge is sorted if for all `i ≤ j`, then `S i ≤ S j`.
declarations.statement: def Sorted {n : ℕ} (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) : Prop

declarations.name: PureU1.sort
declarations.doc: Given a charge assignment `S`, the corresponding sorted charge assignment.
declarations.statement: def sort {n : ℕ} (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) : (PureU1 n).Charges

declarations.name: PureU1.sort_sorted
declarations.statement: lemma sort_sorted {n : ℕ} (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) : Sorted (sort S)

declarations.name: PureU1.sort_perm
declarations.statement:
lemma sort_perm {n : ℕ} (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) (M :(FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    sort ((FamilyPermutations n).rep M S) = sort S

declarations.name: PureU1.sort_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma sort_apply {n : ℕ} (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) (j : Fin n) :
    sort S j = S ((Tuple.sort S) j)

declarations.name: PureU1.sort_zero
declarations.statement: lemma sort_zero {n : ℕ} (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) (hS : sort S = 0) : S = 0

declarations.name: PureU1.sort_projection
declarations.statement: lemma sort_projection {n : ℕ} (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) : sort (sort S) = sort S

declarations.name: PureU1.sortAFL
declarations.doc: The sort function acting on `LinSols`.
declarations.statement: def sortAFL {n : ℕ} (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols) : (PureU1 n).LinSols

declarations.name: PureU1.sortAFL_val
declarations.statement: lemma sortAFL_val {n : ℕ} (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols) : (sortAFL S).val = sort S.val

declarations.name: PureU1.sortAFL_zero
declarations.statement: lemma sortAFL_zero {n : ℕ} (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols) (hS : sortAFL S = 0) : S = 0

modules.title: Vector like charges
modules.doc: For the `n`-even case we define the property of a charge assignment being vector like.

declarations.name: PureU1.split_equal
declarations.doc: Given a natural number `n`, this lemma proves that `n + n` is equal to `2 * n`.
declarations.statement: lemma split_equal (n : ℕ) : n + n = 2 * n

declarations.name: PureU1.split_odd
declarations.statement: lemma split_odd (n : ℕ) : n + 1 + n = 2 * n + 1

declarations.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEven
declarations.doc:
A charge configuration for n even is vector like if when sorted the `i`th element
is equal to the negative of the `n + i`th element.
declarations.statement: def VectorLikeEven (S : (PureU1 (2 * n)).Charges) : Prop
